title: Senior Applied AI Engineer, AI Platform (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at bunch
description_html:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

As a Senior Applied AI Engineer on our AI Platform team, you take AI at bunch from working to relied upon. We already run AI in production — a document extraction pipeline live in fund operations, agent workflows on Mastra, evaluations, and multi-provider fallback inside EU data residency. Fund operations run on documents, deadlines and numbers that have to be right — subscription documents to parse, capital calls to chase, portfolio data to reconcile. You build on that foundation: more agents taking that work off people's hands, the evaluations that prove they can be trusted with it, and the platform that lets every other team at bunch ship the same way. This is end-to-end product engineering, not research: you own architecture, evaluation, integration, and deployment.

Top Priorities

  • Build and ship agents. Design agents that automate real fund-operations workflows, and own them from prototype through production and after. They integrate with our services, data model, and authorization system — they don't sit beside the product as standalone prototypes.

  • Evaluate and improve agent performance. Build the evaluation layer: test cases built from real documents with the output we expect, regression suites in CI, human review where correctness is non-negotiable, and clear success criteria for an agent completing a complex task end to end. Then move the numbers that matter — accuracy, latency, cost.

  • Own the AI application architecture. Orchestration and multi-agent design, tool contracts, memory, and context engineering (RAG, MCP) with clear domain boundaries — plus the guardrails, approvals, and human-in-the-loop controls that anything touching investor money requires.

  • Run it in production. Versioned, feature-flagged rollout of agent versions; rate limits, provider fallback, and regional failover within EU data residency; and the observability to trace a failure across services and turn it into a fix rather than a theory.

  • Make it a platform, not a project. Document parsing and extraction consolidates into this team, and shared evaluation and observability become something other teams consume rather than rebuild. You set the patterns other engineers inherit, partner closely with DevX, and mentor engineers across teams on agent and LLM practice.

Your First 90 Days

  • Review our MCP offering end to end and ship it to the first customers, with the access boundaries, evaluation and observability a customer-facing surface needs.

  • Stand up shared observability for our AI workloads — token usage, estimated cost, latency, failures and retries per provider — on a dashboard people actually open during an incident.

  • Publish v1 of our agent patterns (domain boundaries, tool contracts, prompt and eval conventions), reviewed with DevX and adopted by at least one team outside AI Platform.

About You

  • Experience: 5+ years building production software, including at least one agent or LLM-powered capability you took end to end and still owned once it was live

  • Agents: real depth in orchestration and context engineering — tool contracts, memory, RAG, multi-agent design — with Mastra, ai-sdk, LangGraph or similar. You've integrated agents into a real product and its authorization model, not built prototypes for someone else to productionise

  • Evaluation: you know how to make a non-deterministic system measurable, from test cases built on real data to regression suites and human review, and you can tell the difference between a model that improved and a benchmark that got easier

  • Production: you own what you ship. Reading traces, diagnosing failure modes, tuning cost and latency, handling provider rate limits and fallback without drama

  • Backend: You have experience with TypeScript and/or Python.

  • Platform mindset: you build for other engineers as much as for end users, and the standards you set get adopted because people trust you, not because they are written down

  • Pragmatic: you start from the business outcome, choose the deterministic solution when it's the right one, and know when good enough is good enough

  • Experience in fintech, private markets, or another regulated, document-heavy domain is a plus, as is working under EU data-residency constraints

Our Tech Stack

  • Frontend: TypeScript, Svelte and React

  • Backend: Node.js, Nest.js

  • Database: MySQL, PostgreSQL

  • AI: Mastra, Vercel ai-sdk, Google Vertex (Gemini) with AWS Bedrock fallback in EU regions

  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes on AWS

  • Observability: Datadog

  • Auth & Internal tools: FusionAuth, Retool

Workplace & Benefits

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Hybrid setup (3 days/week in office)

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 130+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring Process

  1. People Team Interview (30 min) – Meet us and check initial fit.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (60 min) – Explore product-focused culture, collaboration, ownership, self-awareness, and quality standards.

  3. Technical Interviews (2 x 60 min) – Two technical conversations, one with our engineers to discuss topics like system and agent-design questions, and one focused on core AI technical topics

  4. Final Round with our CTO Leandro (45 min) – Discuss ways of working, bunch’s engineering vision, and team culture.

Questions? Reach out to ----- style="min-height:1.5em">

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.


____

At bunch, we're committed to an inclusive environment where diversity is valued and celebrated. We provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants.

We process personal data in line with applicable laws (including GDPR). See our Privacy Policy for details on your rights and how to reach us.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Germany
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Ashby
description_html:
Why Join Sales at Ashby

Sales at Ashby is a unique opportunity to sell a product customers genuinely love during an AI-fueled market expansion. Over 5,000 companies rely on Ashby, including OpenAI, Bolt, Statista, Neura Robotics and Monday.com, and our business is durably growing faster than 100% year-over-year. We’re well funded, and on a path to profitability. That's exceptionally rare for a company at our scale, and puts us in the top 10% of benchmarks.

Nearly 1 in 3 of Ashby’s globally distributed team call Europe home! We’ve landed over 1000 customers in EMEA representing ~23% of our global revenue base, with well over 100 in the DACH region, clear evidence of strong product-market fit. We’re doubling down our investment in the region with in-market GTM, CS and Support resources. EU Data Residency and product localisation are committed and coming soon. We believe there is a meaningful opportunity to help modern teams move beyond legacy recruiting software.

Ashby replaces 3-5 tools in a consolidation & efficiency play that’s equally loved by recruiters and CFOs. We’re known as a clear AI-leader in the recruiting space. We are rapidly extending from a best-in-class recruiting product toward a multi-product platform, expanding upmarket, into new industries, and internationally. For sales reps, that means a large market full of legacy tools, and a product portfolio that creates room for both new business and expansion. This is a chance to participate in how a category-defining company wins in its next phase of growth.

We are equally intentional about how we build the business. We have established a remote-first, high-performing sales organization that rewards learning and accountability. We use data to set achievable quotas, and reward sustained impact with competitive compensation and meaningful upside. We prioritize coaching and career development, with AEs advancing to Enterprise & Leadership roles in just a few years — 38% of the team who have been here more than a year have been promoted or taken on a new role!

You will work with people who care about craft, customer outcomes, and winning together—without sacrificing the trust, autonomy, and balance required to do your best work over the long term. Don’t just take my word for it, see what the team has to say about working here.

About this Role

TA tools in the Enterprise represent a huge market opportunity, a $1B+ TAM, and the incumbents are legacy players. We are displacing a collection of tools (ATS, Sourcing & CRM, Scheduling, Analytics, Offers & Approvals) with a consolidated talent suite. This is a proven playbook that Workday used to win the HCM market as customers realize value in a multitude of ways.

We are seeking a German-fluent and Germany-based Enterprise Account Executive to help us win Enterprise (1,000+ employees) accounts by managing the full sales cycle from pipeline generation through to closed-won.

In this role, you'll focus on new logo acquisition. Our emphasis is on your ability to excel in the areas listed below and your appetite for continuous growth & improvement.

You could be a great fit if:

  • 📣 You demonstrate mastery of clear communication. You ask questions with precision and can explain complex concepts in simple terms.

  • 💰 You have strong track record in Enterprise SaaS sales, having closed many $100k sales, and overachieved $1M+ quotas consistently. You have won competitive rip-and-replace opportunities of core/platform technologies.

  • 🎯 You are proactive in identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, and comfortable sourcing >50% of your own pipeline. You're both resourceful and innovative in finding new business opportunities.

  • 💻 You can confidently deliver micro-demos before engaging your SE partners. You can't imagine not being fluent in the product you sell.

  • 🎧 You are highly skilled at discovery. You believe in preparation to establish a point of view, and through discovery validate or refine your perspective to identify a project's business drivers aligned to executive priorities.

  • 🤝 You have strong business acumen. You quickly connect the dots between technical problems and their downstream business impacts. You craft compelling business cases with this context.

  • ⚔️ You're adept at competitive or evangelical selling in new or established markets.

  • 🏔️ You skillfully guide prospects through the evaluation—engaging the right stakeholders at the right time to create consensus for a strategic technology decision.

  • 🤓 You enjoy becoming an expert and tailoring discussions to address each prospect’s unique challenges.

  • ⚡️ Your peers describe you as action-oriented and persistent. You're always on the leaderboard for outbound effort and pipeline created.

  • 🔍 Your peers describe you as detail oriented. You write and send crisp follow-up emails, on time. You also take pride in internal operations, like real-time CRM updates. (We use HubSpot, Gong, Chili Piper and Apollo.)

  • ✈️ You are willing to travel at least 25% of the time for customer engagements and events.

Requirements:

  • 🤝 You have 5+ years of full-cycle closing experience and have closed many >$100,000 ACV opportunities

  • 📢 You have experience selling complex platform technologies in a sales-led GTM motion

  • 📈 You are a new business hunter and are confident in your abilities to self-source >50% of your own pipeline

  • 🌍 You have sold to multiple regions within EMEA and have strong written and verbal fluency in both English and German

  • 🇩🇪 You are based in Germany

Bonus Points:

  • 🤝 You have experience selling to Talent or People leaders

You shouldn't apply if:

  • 💼 You're more of a relationship builder who focuses on selling into the install base and aren't excited about a new business focused role.

  • 🎯 You expect Marketing or BDRs to source all of your pipeline for you. This is a hunting role.

  • 💻 You believe that "tech stuff" is the SE's job. Our AEs all develop product acumen while SEs are a partner in our team selling motion.

  • 📊 You prefer to run established playbooks in well defined environments. This role requires creativity and a growth mindset.

  • 🐺 You're a lone wolf. You prefer to go it alone in your pursuit of new business. We believe in a team-selling sales model.

Interview Process

Our interview process is thorough — we aim to ensure each person that joins the team is the right fit for Ashby and will provide ample information for you to assess if Ashby is the right fit for you. The process for this role is as follows:

  • Intro Call (30 min) - You'll meet with a Recruiter to discuss your fit for the role and address questions about our market and solution.

  • Written Exercise - You'll complete a short take home assignment to showcase your outbound muscle.

  • Experience Deep Dive (60 min) - You'll walk the Hiring Manager [Casper Bergmans] through your career journey in some detail to highlight your experience, achievements, and points of learning to understand how you've developed into the professional you are today.

  • Challenge Interview (90 min) - This will be made up of two parts:

    • Discovery and Demo Role Play (60 min)

    • Deal Strategy Discussion (30 min)

Benefits

  • Compelling benefits offerings, location dependent

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

We're in the talent acquisition software business. We run the end-to-end hiring process through our own platform, and ensure a level playing field for all candidates. Reaching out to hiring managers or recruiters directly won't improve your odds of success. Please focus your energy on the quality of your application.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

Compensation: €230K – €300K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission

title: Team Lead Engineering - Finance Automation
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Zeal Network
description_html:
ZEAL Network SE is a dynamic, international group of companies that has been creating exciting and innovative lottery experiences for over 20 years. As Germany’s largest provider of online lotteries through our brands LOTTO24 and Tipp24, and a trusted partner of Spain’s ONCE, the second-largest national lottery, we’re shaping the future of the lottery industry. We are passionate about driving innovation, as demonstrated by our newest brands, Freiheit+ and Traumhausverlosung, which bring fresh and exciting dreams to life. Additionally, through ZEAL Ventures, we invest in inspiring e-commerce start-ups like Omaze and DAYMADE, fueling fresh ideas and opportunities.

Our team of 350+ professionals from diverse backgrounds is united by a visionary mindset, a passion for collaboration, and a commitment to inspire dreams. At ZEAL, we empower our people to think ambitiously and work together toward a shared purpose: helping people imagine and achieve their aspirations.

As our Engineering Team Lead (f/m/d), your team’s mission is to own a brand-new Core Platform domain focused on Finance. As the Tech Lead of the Finance Automation team, you will translate financial and accounting requirements into scalable platform capabilities that automate reconciliation, improve data integrity, and enable reliable financial operations.

Your tasks:

  • You lead a product-focused engineering team that builds and evolves Zeal's core B2B platform capabilities for internal business customers

  • In collaboration with your PM you act as the primary partner between Finance and Core Platform Engineering building trusted relationships and translating financial requirements into scalable platform capabilities.

  • Drive the automation of reconciliation, accounting workflows, and financial data processing, reducing manual effort and increasing operational reliability.

  • Ensure the reliability, integrity, and auditability of finance-critical data across platform services and infrastructure changes.

  • Hire, Build and lead a team of 2 engineers: Hire, develop, and grow a high-performing team, fostering an ownership-driven and reliability-focused engineering culture

  • Lead technically and strategically, define and drive architectural decisions together with your team

  • Code as part of the team: While guiding architecture and strategy, you’ll regularly write code, contribute to features, and help solve complex technical challenges together with your team

title: Operational Excellence Specialist
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Rohlik
description_html:
Rohlík Group is one of Europe’s fastest-growing online grocery platforms, changing how people eat and live. Founded in 2014 in the Czech Republic, we’ve grown into a trusted brand with more than one million customers across Czechia, Hungary, Austria, Germany, and Romania.

Our mission is simple to make everyday shopping faster, easier, and more sustainable. We combine smart technology, efficient logistics, and a genuine love for great food. From local bakeries and farmers to our own private labels, we make sure every product that reaches our customers is fresh, safe, and top-quality.

We’re committed to sustainability and supporting local communities, reducing packaging, and working closely with small producers. For our customers, Rohlik Group is more than just shopping, it's a better way to enjoy good food every day.

Department Overview

The Operational Excellence team drives continuous improvement, process standardization, and innovation across Last Mile operations. We support local teams in implementing group standards, solving systemic challenges in routing, loading, and delivery, and enabling sustainable growth as we scale.

 

Role Overview

As Operational Excellence Manager for Last Mile, you will own the design and delivery of a 3 to 6 month continuous improvement roadmap for last mile operations. You will lead adoption of group standards, embed best practices, and deliver sustainable improvements in delivery efficiency, cost per order, and on-time performance. You will partner with central and local stakeholders to find the real bottlenecks in the last mile flow, from route assignment and loading through to the delivery itself, and roll out scalable solutions across sites.

 

What we expect from you

  • Owns the last mile improvement roadmap and makes sure initiatives are delivered on time.

  • Owns initiatives end to end, including group-wide projects: frames the problem, builds and defends the business case, runs the pilot, measures and evaluates the impact, and scales what works across sites.

  • Leads adoption of operational best practices in loading, routing, and delivery through coaching and influence.

  • Partners with group-level development and performance management teams and local site teams to coordinate projects and current performance.

  • Reads the problem in the real operation as well as in the data, tells the true cause apart from the noise, and turns the fix into a standard.

  • Documents processes (VSM, process maps).

 

What we look for

 

Required

  • 3+ years of operational experience owning projects or programs in the last mile for retail.

  • Strong leadership and coaching capability.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management.

  • Analytical thinker who can define metrics, read data, and separate cause from correlation.

  • Project management experience.

  • Willingness to travel 2 to 3 days per week across sites.

 

Preferred

  • Background in e-commerce, grocery, or same-day delivery.

  • Six Sigma and/or project management certification.

 

What’s in it for you

  • Fair reward - You’ll get a strong fixed salary, no bonus games, no politics. Great work is rewarded clearly and fairly.

  • Good food every day - You’ll enjoy a free lunch every day and fresh fruit & veggies in the office. Because good food fuels great work.

  • Life, not just work - You’ll have real flexibility three days in the office, 2 days at the Home Office where it suits you. And unlimited paid vacation based on trust.

  • Personal growth - You’ll grow as fast as Rohlik does. Every challenge is a chance to learn and make an impact.

  • Real impact - What you do here matters. You’ll see your work changing how people eat and live from day one.

  • Recognition among colleagues - Your effort won’t go unnoticed. You can recognise others (and be recognised) through peer credits to use in our internal cafeteria.

  • Xtra membership - You’ll get free Xtra membership and 10% cashback on everything you buy on Rohlik

  • A team that sticks together - You’ll work with people who move fast, support each other and celebrate wins together.

  • If this sounds like you - You’re someone who takes ownership, acts fast and gets things done. Ready to bake something great with us?

#LI-ML1 #Knuspr

title: SEA Manager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Sunlab GmbH
description_html:
Hey, wir sind Sunlab – schön, dass du vorbeischaust.

Du willst SEA nicht nur operativ steuern, sondern strategisch weiterentwickeln, Budgets mit Weitblick führen und echten Impact erzielen? Perfekt – genau das ist unser Anspruch.

Wir arbeiten am liebsten mit Category Killern oder Kunden, die es noch werden wollen.

Als datengetriebenes Team aus Aschaffenburg und Hamburg ist es unsere Mission, Search kontinuierlich auf das nächste Level zu heben: Potenziale identifizieren, versteckte Wachstumshebel aufdecken und Kampagnen so steuern, dass Performance messbar skaliert.

Klartext: Schwankender ROAS, steigende CPCs oder umkämpfte Märkte sind für uns keine Ausrede, sondern eine strategische Herausforderung. Wir arbeiten langfristig und vorausschauend – mit klarer Struktur, sauberem Tracking und einem tiefen Verständnis für Geschäftsmodelle.

Du betreust keine 25 Accounts im Blindflug. Stattdessen arbeitest du eng mit 2–3 ausgewählten Kunden zusammen, die du strategisch entwickelst und aktiv voranbringst. Du agierst auf Augenhöhe, steuerst signifikante Budgets und holst das Maximum aus Google Ads & Co. heraus.

Wir sind ambitionierte Macher und glauben daran, dass die perfekte Kombination aus Daten, smarten Strategien und Technologie den Unterschied macht. In den kommenden Monaten werden wir mutiger testen, gezielter skalieren und stärker automatisieren, um das Maximum herauszuholen.

Um unsere Mission weiter voranzubringen, suchen wir dich als
SEA Manager (m/w/d)

Aufgaben

Dein Verantwortungsbereich

  • Kundenberatung: Du betreust Bestands- und Neukunden mit teils 7-stelligen Budgets und kommunizierst proaktiv und transparent
  • Ads-Management & -Innovation: Du schaltest Ads auf verschiedenen Plattformen, behältst Performance und Monitoring im Blick & testest neue Google Ad Formate und Targeting-Möglichkeiten
  • Optimierung & Reporting: Du entwickelst Kampagnen stetig weiter, steigerst ihre Effizienz und erstellst Reports mit verschiedenen Google-Tools

Qualifikation

Dein Background

  • 1-2 Jahre Erfahrung im SEA-Bereich
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Google Ads, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio & Google Spreadsheets
  • Hands-on-Mentalität & schnelle Auffassungsgabe
  • Bereitschaft zur permanenten Weiterentwicklung
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- & Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

Deine Benefits

  • Flexibles Arbeiten, keine Onsite-Pflichttage
  • Rundum Versorgung im top modernen Headquarter am bayerischen Untermain, Fitnessraum, Gaming Room auf über 1.600 qm uvm.
  • Flache Hierarchien & kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Ein starkes Onboarding, regelmäßige Weiterbildungen & Konferenzen

Also, bewirb dich noch heute und setze dich an unserer Seite dafür ein, unsere Kunden in die Pole Position zu bekommen. Wir freuen uns schon darauf, dich bald kennenzulernen.

Julia und das Team von Sunlab

PS: Du kannst uns auch einfach anrufen 06021 4228997 oder auf LinkedIn eine Nachricht schicken.

title: Leiter Personalverwaltung (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Deutsche Energy Terminal GmbH
description_html:
Wollen Sie Ihre berufliche Zukunft in einem wegweisenden Projekt gestalten? Bei der Deutschen Energy Terminal GmbH (DET) in Düsseldorf erwartet Sie eine spannende Herausforderung. Im Auftrag des Bundesministeriums für Wirtschaft und Energie entwickelt und betreibt die Deutsche Energy Terminal GmbH (DET) die vier schwimmenden LNG-Terminals an der deutschen Nordseeküste, über die LNG vom Schiff in das Gasnetz eingespeist wird. Die sogenannten Floating Storage and Regasification Units (FSRU) sind von entscheidender Bedeutung für die Versorgungssicherheit Deutschlands und damit kritische Infrastruktur mit hohem Risikopotenzial. Wir suchen motivierte Talente, die aktiv an der Gestaltung unseres Verantwortungsbereichs teilhaben möchten. Bewerben Sie sich noch heute und gestalten Sie die Zukunft mit uns!

Aufgaben

  • Strategische und operative Gesamtverantwortung für die Personalverwaltung und das Personalwesen.
  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Personalstrategie im Einklang mit den Unterneh­menszielen.
  • Aufbau eines zukunftsorientierten Workforce-Managements und Sicherung des Fach­kräftebedarfs.
  • Verantwortung für Personalplanung, Recruiting, Personalentwicklung sowie Vergü­tungs- und Arbeitszeitmodelle.
  • Sicherstellung der Einhaltung arbeits-, tarif- und steuerrechtlicher Vorgaben.
  • Führung und Entwicklung des HR-Bereichs sowie Optimierung der HR-Pro­zesse.
  • Steuerung von Change- und Transformationsprozessen.
  • Förderung einer leistungsfähigen, wertschätzenden Unternehmenskultur und Arbeit­geberattraktivität.
  • Verantwortung für HR-Budget, Kennzahlen und Personalcontrolling.
  • Vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Arbeitnehmervertretungen und externen Partnern sowie Repräsentation des Unternehmens in relevanten Netz­werken.

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung im Management komplexer HR Prozesse, insbesondere Budgetplanung, HR Kennzahlen, Steuerungsinstrumenten und strategischem Controlling
  • Know how im strategischem HR Management, Organisationsentwicklung und Perso­nalführung auf oberer Managementebene
  • Gute Kenntnisse im Arbeitsrecht, Tarifrecht, Mitbestimmungsrecht sowie in regulato­rischen Rahmenbedingungen der HR Arbeit
  • Erfahrung in Kommunikation, Verhandlung, Konfliktlösung mit hoher sozialer Kompe­tenz in Personalangelegenheiten
  • Deutsch: Muttersprache, Englisch: gute Kenntnisse

Idealerweise verfügen Sie außerdem über folgende Qualifikationen:

  • Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft
  • Erfahrung in Employer Branding, Talentmanagement und Kompetenzentwicklung
  • Wissen zu modernen HR‑Trends (z. B. Digitalisierung, People Analytics, New Work, agile Organisationsformen)

Benefits

  • Teilhabe an der Erfüllung einer Aufgabe, die für die Versorgungssicherheit Deutschlands und seiner Nachbarn von entscheidender Bedeutung ist
  • Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
  • Aus- und Fortbildung
  • Ein dynamisches Umfeld mit abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben und hoher Eigenverantwortung
  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Homeoffice nach Vereinbarung
  • Wir arbeiten stetig an weiteren Vorteilen für unsere Mitarbeitenden: aktuell bieten wir eine medizinische Gesundheitsvorsorge, die Kostenübernahme des Deutschland-Tickets sowie einen attraktiven Arbeitsplatz als weitere Benefits

Bereit, den Energiemarkt mitzugestalten?
Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung; auch, wenn Sie vielleicht nicht alle Stichpunkte erfüllen.
Gemeinsam sichern wir die Energieversorgung von heute – und gestalten die Infrastruktur von morgen.

title: Geoinformatikerin/GIS-Entwicklerin (m/w/d) in Voll- bzw. Teilzeit (min. 32 Std.)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at ZEBRIS Geo-IT GmbH
description_html:
Willkommen bei ZEBRIS Geo-IT GmbH! Wir sind ein kleines, dynamisches Team in München, das mit Leidenschaft an spannenden Projekten im Bereich Geoinformatik arbeitet. Unsere Mission ist es, nachhaltige Lösungen für das Management natürlicher Ressourcen zu entwickeln. Als Geoinformatikerin/GIS-Entwicklerin (m/w/d) wirst Du Teil eines innovativen Unternehmens, das die Erde mit modernster Technologie und kreativen Ansätzen besser verstehen und schützen möchte. Bei uns kannst Du in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit (mindestens 32 Stunden) arbeiten und hast die Möglichkeit, in einem flexiblen und unterstützenden Umfeld deine Ideen einzubringen. Wenn Du ein Faible für die Arbeit mit Geodaten hast und der Schutz unseres Klimas, unseres Trinkwassers ebenso wie Naturschutz und internationale Entwicklung für Dich wichtig sind, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Wir freuen uns darauf, gemeinsam mit Dir an zukunftsweisenden Projekten zu arbeiten.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Weiterentwicklung und Pflege unserer Software LandManager auf der Basis von QGIS und Geoserver zum nachhaltigen Management von Trinkwasserschutzgebieten und anderen Anwendungen
  • Datenanalyse und Entwicklung von Prozessierungsketten für GIS- und Fernerkundungsdaten mit Python und R
  • Entwicklung von Modellen des maschinellen Lernens für die Auswertung von Fernerkundungsdaten (Drohnen und Satelliten)
  • Anwendung und Einführung von KI-Tools im Entwicklungsprozess
  • Kundenberatung und Second-Level Support für unsere Anwendungen

Qualifikation

Du bringst über die von Dir gesprochenen Programmiersprachen hinaus gute Deutsch- und Englisch-Kenntnisse mit. Französischkenntnisse sind für unsere internationalen Projekte von Vorteil. Du freust sich darauf, selbstständig Lösungen zu entwickeln und Dich im Team mit einzubringen. Auf Deine analytischen Fähigkeiten ist auch bei komplexen Fragestellungen ebenso Verlass wie auf Deine sorgfältige und vorausschauende Arbeitsweise. Du weisst, dass gute Entwicklerarbeit nicht nur hinter dem Bildschirm, sondern auch im direkten Kontakt mit Kunden und Anwendern stattfindet.

Du hast ein abgeschlossene (Fach-)Hochschulausbildung der Geoinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und verfügst über erste Berufserfahrung.

Du solltest in folgenden Bereichen Erfahrung mitbringen:

  • Entwicklung von QGIS-Plugins mit Python
  • Entwicklung von Datenprozessierungsanwendungen mit Python und R
  • Grundkenntnisse in Webentwicklung mit HTML, CSS und JavaScript
  • Grundkenntnisse GeoServer sowie Verarbeitung und Bereitstellung von Geodaten
  • Auswertung von Satelliten- und Fernerkundungsdaten mit Methoden des MLs
  • Datenbanken: PostgreSQL/PostGIS und MS SQL Server
  • Betriebssysteme: Windows und Linux
  • Agile Entwicklungsmethoden und Projektmanagement-Tools, z.B. Jira

Benefits

  • Abwechslungsreiches Arbeiten in einem kleinen dynamischen Team im Zentrum von München
  • Gute Perspektiven mit Möglichkeiten zur Qualifizierung und Weiterbildung
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und eigenständiges Arbeiten

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Mitarbeiter an fünf Standorten in Deutschland.

Wir möchten insbesondere Frauen dazu ermutigen, sich bei uns zu bewerben.

Aufgaben

Im Rahmen deines Studiums erhältst du die Möglichkeit, Praxiserfahrung bei einem der besten Arbeitgeber Berlin Brandenburgs zu sammeln. Entsprechend deines Studienschwerpunkts wirst du innerhalb der Praxisphasen in verschiedenen Abteilungen eingesetzt. Du erhältst so einen Einblick in nahezu alle Bereiche einer Software-Firma:

  • Auch der Vertrieb freut sich auf deine Unterstützung bei Kundenanfragen, Softwarepräsentationen und Messen
  • In der Entwicklung unterstützt du das Team bei der Programmierung unserer Projektmanagement-Software
  • Auch ein Einblick in die Verwaltung oder unsere Unternehmenskommunikation und das Marketing ist jederzeit möglich

Benefits

  • Moderne Büros: Sitz-Steh-Tische, helle und ruhige Räume, ergonomische Arbeitsplätze

Du liebst datenbasierte Erfolge genauso sehr wie einen richtig guten Kaffee in deinem Lieblingscafé? Perfekt! title: Senior Product Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Haiilo 1
description_html:
At Haiilo, we're building the digital home that connects employees with the information that matters to them — reliably, efficiently, every day.

As our Senior Product Manager for the Analytics team, you own the strategy and execution for our analytics product area end-to-end. You work hands-on with a dedicated product team - partnering closely with engineering and design to turn data into meaningful product experiences that help our customers understand and act on what's happening in their organisation.

This role is hybrid with two office days per week in Hamburg.

🌟 What's in it for you:

  • Access to OpenUp for you, your family and friends
  • Urban Sports Club or Wellpass membership
  • Lease a Bike scheme
  • Deutschlandticket subsidy
  • 30 days holiday + 2 additional self-care days
  • Lots of room to make your mark in a growing software company
  • Modern processes and short decision-making paths — no endless approval loops

Who we're looking for

  • 5+ years of proven experience as a Product Manager in a B2B SaaS environment, ideally with a focus on analytics or data products
  • Solid understanding of modern product discovery and product management practices
  • Strong communication, analytical thinking, and ability to work in a global, fast-moving environment
  • Comfortable owning a product roadmap - from identifying opportunities to communicating changes to stakeholders
  • Fluent english skills, german is a nice to have

What you'll do

  • Own and drive the day-to-day roadmap for the analytics product area, balancing strategic direction with hands-on execution
  • Work closely with your engineering lead and UI/UX designer to deliver high-quality analytics experiences
  • Develop and maintain a clear product roadmap aligned to Haiilo's overall product strategy
  • Identify market trends, customer needs and opportunities to drive meaningful innovation in analytics and data
  • Act as the key liaison between your product team and internal stakeholders — keeping communication structured, clear and consistent
  • Be the go-to person for product requests and ensure they're handled in a structured, transparent way
  • Foster a culture of agility, collaboration and continuous improvement within your team

title: Data Engineer (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Climate
description_html:
Job description

We are currently seeking a Data Engineer for our international and diverse Climate Policy Team (CPT). The team is engaged in various projects on climate change mitigation, in particular on energy system transformation, the 1.5°C global warming limit and the evaluation of national climate action. This includes flagship projects, such as the Climate Action Tracker and the National Pathways Explorer, for which data is being processed and analysed in-house and then published on the respective project websites.


As a Data Engineer you will play a critical role in designing, building and maintaining our data infrastructure, ensuring efficient and accurate data processing, storage and retrieval. 


Your Responsibilities

  • You will help to build and maintain a data platform for advanced analytics and climate modelling, spanning data science and data engineering work.

  • Contribute to the full lifecycle of data platform development from design and deployment to continuous improvement

  • Strengthen data pipelines reliability, observability, and automation through code and tooling improvements.

  • Collaborate with data scientists and researchers to define data processing requirements.

  • Support AI/LLM initiatives across the organisation from a data and infrastructure perspective.

  • Help develop backend data services and APIs that expose curated datasets to internal and external consumers and applications.

  • Monitor, anticipate, and resolve operational or data quality issues in data pipelines. Ensure data reliability.


Relevant Tech Skills

Please note that this list is non exhaustive and that if you don’t have experience on some of those you should still apply.


Required:

  • Python

  • SQL

  • PostgreSQL

  • Object storage (like S3/Minio)

  • Containers (like Docker)

  • Git

  • CI/CD principles


Nice to have:

  • Pandas/Polar/DuckDB or other framework for data processing

  • Conda

  • Monitoring tools (like Prometheus, Grafana and Elasticsearch)

  • Infrastructure as code tool (like Terraform or Ansible)

  • AI‑driven productivity tools


Your profile

You will ideally have the following qualifications and skills: 

  • You have a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, ideally with a specialization in Data Engineering or DevOps, or a related field.

  • You have gained initial experience as a Data Engineer in a production environment.

  • Foundational notions in data modeling, data structures, algorithms, design patterns, optimization.

  • Familiarity with the relevant tech skills mentioned above.

  • Basic understanding of data pipelines, APIs, or backend services.

  • Exposure to data engineering in the context of Agentic AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Business Intelligence across different types of data formats (structured vs unstructured) and processing methods.

  • Passionate about working at the intersection of Climate Science and Data Engineering (tell us about relevant projects you’ve worked on!).

  • A problem solver, a fixer, and a creative technologist. We believe coding is a talent and a passion, not just a skill.

  • A strong communicator and a team player who can work efficiently with others, in a diverse, interdisciplinary and international team.

  • Exceptional time management in a complex and largely autonomous work environment.

  • Good communication skills in English


Our offer

  • A job with a purpose. You will work in an international team of highly engaged people and contribute to our work in the field of climate change mitigation

  • A positive and inspiring working atmosphere in an international team. Our Berlin office is located near Moritzplatz in the heart of Kreuzberg

  • Hybrid office policy and flexible start time

  • Fully funded Germany-wide public transport ticket

  • 40 € monthly company contribution to Urban Sports Club membership

  • Online mental health and wellbeing platform

  • Free German language classes

  • Bike rental discount

  • Optional company pension plan


Conditions

  • Application deadline: Open until filled

  • Start date: As soon as possible

  • Duration: We are looking for a long-term collaboration. Currently we can offer a fixed term contract for 12 months with the perspective of extension based on performance and funding.

  • Remuneration: The range is EUR 4,363 (Masters plus 5+ relevant years outside of university studies) to EUR 4,810 (9+ years relevant experience outside of Masters'), in accordance with level 4 steps 1 to 3 of our remuneration scales

  • Vacation: 29 days paid annual leave for each year worked (pro rata) + one day gifted around Christmas.


Please apply with your CV and a cover letter addressing essential criteria, listing of three references, and include your earliest start date and salary expectations. Please use PDF format exclusively using the application form. Applications by email or by post can unfortunately not be processed.


We are a diverse and inclusive team and welcome your application regardless of your gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect that makes you unique.

title: (Senior) B2B Operations Manager (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Stapelstein
description_html:
Über die Rolle

Als B2B Operations Manager entwickelst du die Prozesse, Datenflüsse und Arbeitsweisen unseres B2B-Bereichs. Du nutzt Daten, Automatisierung und KI, um manuelle Arbeit zu reduzieren und Abläufe skalierbar zu machen. So kann sich das Team stärker auf Kunden, Partnerschaften und Wachstum konzentrieren.

Unser CRM befindet sich im finalen Aufbau. Du übernimmst die fachliche Verantwortung dafür, wie B2B-Prozesse im CRM abgebildet werden: Du erkennst Engpässe in der Datenpflege und den Workflows, formulierst Anforderungen an Struktur und Automatisierung und setzt neue Abläufe gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Teams um - von der Abbildung von Lead-Qualifizierung und Onboarding über Pricing- und Konditionslogik bis zu Partnerkommunikation und Shop-Prozessen.


Deine Aufgaben

B2B-Prozesse & Operations (ca. 60%)

  • Du übernimmst 0-to-1-Ownership für unsere B2B-Prozesse, von der Lead-Qualifizierung über das Onboarding bis zur laufenden Partnerbetreuung. Wo heute kein sauberer Ablauf existiert, baust du einen.
  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zu CRM und Automation: Du verstehst die Datenflüsse, erkennst Engpässe und formulierst klare Anforderungen, die Data & AI und IT technisch umsetzen. CRM-Hygiene ist für dich die Grundlage jeder verlässlichen Auswertung.
  • Du verbindest Sales, Supply Chain, Finance und Product zu reibungslosen Abläufen mit klaren Verantwortlichkeiten und treibst bereichsübergreifende Projekte voran.
  • Du definierst und trackst zentrale KPIs (Conversion Rate, Pipeline-Geschwindigkeit, Lead-Qualität, Customer Value) und baust Reporting, das dem Team echte Steuerungsintelligenz gibt, keine Zahlenfriedhöfe.
  • Du hältst fest, was funktioniert: Du machst Best Practices zu Playbooks und SOPs und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Team wirklich genutzt werden.
Operatives Enabling (ca. 40%)
  • Du verantwortest B2B-Newsletter und Partner-Kommunikation: Du bringst die richtigen Aktionen zu den richtigen Partnergruppen und wertest ihre Wirkung aus (Open Rate, CTR, Conversion).
  • Du entwickelst unsere Pricing- und Konditionenlogik mit und pflegst sie sauber in Shop und CRM: kommerziell durchdacht, konsistent, nachvollziehbar.
  • Du betreust unseren B2B-Shop und den Education-Shop: Produktzugänge, Kollektionen, Bundles, kleinere Anpassungen, und du begleitest die Shop-Migration.
  • Du sicherst die Qualität unserer Produktdaten: vollständig, korrekt, verlässlich.


Dein Profil

  • Du hast 3-4+ Jahre Erfahrung in einer Sales-Organisation, Commercial/Sales Operations, Strategieberatung oder einem Scale-up gesammelt. Ein Hintergrund in einer Strategieberatung oder Business Development ist ein Pluspunkt.
  • Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit HubSpot und bewegst dich sicher in CRM-Systemen und digitalen Workflows.
  • Du bist ein hands-on Generalist: Du denkst in Prozessen und Systemen, setzt selbst um statt zu delegieren, und dir ist keine Aufgabe zu klein. 
  • Du hast bereits komplexe, bereichsübergreifende Projekte eigenständig geführt - von Scoping und Business Case über die Umsetzung bis zur Verankerung im Team (SOPs, Playbooks, Trainings).
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch: Du erkennst Chancen, priorisierst nach Wirkung und Skalierbarkeit und triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen.
  • Du arbeitest stark analytisch: Du bewegst dich sicher in großen Datenmengen und Spreadsheets und ziehst daraus klare, umsetzbare Schlüsse.
  • Du hast eine hohe KI- und Datenaffinität: Du hast KI-Tools bereits praktisch in deiner Arbeit eingesetzt und möchtest sie zu einem festen Bestandteil deiner Arbeitsweise machen. Du prüfst Ergebnisse kritisch, experimentierst mit neuen Ansätzen und lernst schnell. 
  • Du strukturierst fachliche Bedarfe und übersetzt sie in umsetzbare Anforderungen an Prozesse, Daten und Systeme. Dabei kommunizierst du klar und zielgruppengerecht innerhalb des Unternehmens.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und kommunizierst sicher auf Englisch.


Was uns wichtig ist

  • Stapelstein ist für dich kein Job - sondern eine Mission, hinter der du wirklich stehst. 
  • Für dich ist ein respektvoller, empathischer Umgang keine Checkbox - sondern die Basis, auf der gute Zusammenarbeit entsteht.
  • Herausforderungen bremsen dich nicht - sie machen dich neugierig. 
  • Du denkst kreativ und unternehmerisch - du findest Wege, wo andere Hindernisse sehen, und machst dich in deinen Rollen wirklich wirkungsvoll. 
  • Du übernimmst echte Verantwortung und triffst Entscheidungen mit Überzeugung - ohne dass jemand fragen muss. 
  • Du brauchst keine Struktur von außen - du schaffst sie dir selbst. 
  • Du nutzt KI nicht, weil es alle tun - sondern weil du verstanden hast, dass es die Art, wie wir arbeiten, grundlegend verändert.


Was wir bieten

  • Der Start ist jederzeit möglich. 
  • Ein marktübliches, faires Gehaltspaket. 
  • Remote-first - in Deutschland und zeitweise auch aus dem Ausland. 
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit einer gemeinsamen Kernzeit von 9-12 Uhr. 
  • Überstunden werden vollständig durch Freizeitausgleich ausgeglichen. 
  • Vollzeit bedeutet bei uns 36 Stunden pro Woche - für mehr Fokus und mehr Lebenszeit. Ergänzt wird das durch 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr. 
  • Monatliche Team-Meet-ups in Stuttgart oder Berlin. Zeit, um gemeinsam im selben Raum zu arbeiten, Projekte voranzubringen und sich persönlich auszutauschen. 
  • Zwei inspirierende Offsites pro Jahr, weil echtes Teamgefühl trotz Remote-first seinen Raum braucht. 
  • Flexible Benefits wie Einkaufsbudget, Mobilitätszuschuss oder Urban Sports - nach bestandener Probezeit.

title: (Senior) Key Account Manager - Automotive | Climate Tech startup
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Carbmee
description_html:
Intro

This is a role for someone who wants to own something real, not just execute on someone else's vision.
At Carbmee, we're building the environmental intelligence platform that the world's largest industrial companies use to measure, manage, and reduce their carbon emissions. We work with companies like Maersk, Lufthansa, and Zeiss. And we're growing fast!
As (Senior) Key Account Manager, you'll own and grow our automotive customer base. You'll have real responsibility from day one, and what you build here will actually matter.
You'll spend the majority of your time deepening relationships with existing enterprise accounts (expansion, additional use cases, renewals) while also opening a smaller number of new strategic accounts in the automotive and industrial supplier space.

You'll work directly with our CEO and sales leadership to build the account strategy from the ground up.


Your tasks

  • Own a portfolio of existing automotive enterprise accounts, driving expansion and deepening carbmee's footprint.
  • Identify, develop and close new strategic accounts in automotive and adjacent supplier industries.
  • Build multi-threaded relationships across sustainability, procurement, and operations stakeholders at large automotive OEMs and Tier 1/2 suppliers.
  • Translate carbmee's carbon accounting and environmental intelligence platform into concrete value for automotive-specific challenges (CBAM, Scope 3, supply chain decarbonization)
  • Run a consultative, value-based sales process (MEDDIC or SPICED) rather than a feature-led pitch
  • Partner closely with our Field Deployment Engineers team to ensure accounts are set up to renew and expand
  • Be a thought partner on how outcome-based and AI-driven selling motions layer on top of traditional SaaS sales


Your profile

  • 3+ years in enterprise SaaS sales or key account management, with a strong trajectory (quota overachievement, fast progression) weighted more heavily than years alone
  • Experience selling into automotive OEMs or Tier 1/2 suppliers, and fluency in the transformation challenges the industry is facing
  • Background from a PLM, enterprise software, or value-based SaaS environment, ideally with automotive or industrial manufacturing exposure
  • Prior startup or high-growth company experience: you know what it's like to build process, not just execute it
  • Proven quota attainment and a track record of growing existing accounts, not just closing new ones
  • Fluent German and English
  • Based in or willing to relocate to Munich: this role requires in-person presence (3 days x week) with the team and close collaboration with customer-facing colleagues.


Benefits

  • Unique & Powerful Mission: join a fast-growing and ambitious tech company that is shaping the future of carbon management and fighting climate change
  • Compensation & Rewards: a steep learning curve and ownership from day one. We offer an attractive compensation package, including virtual stock options
  • Health & Wellbeing: Urban Sports Club subscription to stay healthy & fit.1:1 coaching sessions with Nilohealth for your mental well-being.
  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance:  A hybrid setup with 3 days/week in our Munich office. Real collaboration time with the team, plus the flexibility to structure the rest of your week where you focus best.
  • Team Culture: Our transparency, Humility, and Accountability values create a unique and supportive working environment. Be part of a multinational, motivated team that thinks work should be fun!
  • Connection & Networking: Summer Offsite, Winter Party, and regular team events We give you plenty of opportunities to connect with people, strengthen cross-functional relationships, and boost collaboration
  • Trust & Transparency: monthly All-Hands Meetings, weekly update newsletters, and Founders Q&As. We keep you informed on current company numbers and goals

title: (Senior) Consultant Sustainability Advisory | Climate Tech startup

description_html:
Intro

In this high-impact role, you will work with leading industrial companies to turn climate targets into decisions, and you will see the result twice: in their P&L and in their emissions curve.

At carbmee, we're building the environmental intelligence platform that the world's largest industrial companies use to measure, manage, and reduce their carbon emissions. We work with companies like Schaeffler, ZF, Knorr Bremse. And we're growing fast!

As (Senior) Consultant, Sustainability Advisory, you'll own client engagements from scoping to delivery, help build the pipeline that funds them, and shape how our advisory offering is packaged as the practice grows. You'll have real responsibility from day one, and what you build here will actually matter.

If you're not just looking for your next job, but your next big step, carbmee is the right next step for your career!

We'd love to hear from you.


Your tasks

  • Deliver billable advisory engagements end to end: scoping, hypothesis-driven analysis, quantification, client deliverables and presentation. You'll lead smaller engagements and drive workstreams on larger ones.
  • Shape and grow our advisory pipeline: turn client and software conversations into scoped opportunities, and write the proposals - approach, scope, pricing - that win them, working closely with Sales.
  • Help productise the advisory offering: turn recurring client questions into repeatable, priced packages with clear deliverables, duration and day rates.
  • Act as the sustainability subject matter expert for Sales and the Supplier Engagement team: EU regulation (CBAM, CSRD, EUDR, EU ETS), Scope 3 methodology and decarbonisation levers, supporting deal narratives, workshops and customer sessions.
  • Bridge software and advisory: build advisory work on carbmee's EIS output, feed client needs back into Product, and spot expansion opportunities in accounts.
  • Own the operating discipline for your accounts: time tracking, pipeline hygiene, project margin, and monthly input into the consulting scorecard.


Your profile

  • You've spent 3-6 years in a consulting environment, with sustainability as your core focus, not a side project.
  • You know carbon accounting and decarbonisation (Scope 1/2/3) and EU regulation (CBAM, CSRD, EUDR, EU ETS) well enough to explain their commercial implications to a client.
  • You've owned client-facing workstreams: structuring a problem, quantifying a business case, and presenting it to Head-of or C-level stakeholders.
  • You've contributed to proposals or pitches, not just delivery:  you know how a deal gets won, not only how it gets executed.
  • You're at consulting standard in PowerPoint/Google Slides and Excel/Sheets, with a hypothesis-driven storyline and full ownership of your own numbers.

title: Director Strategic Operations (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Matrix42
description_html:
Your mission

YOUR MISSION
As Director, Strategic Operations, you will act as a force multiplier for our CEO and executive team. You will turn strategy into clear priorities, decisions and measurable execution, while creating the governance and transparency that help our leadership focus on the opportunities with the greatest value for Matrix42.

Your key responsibilities would look like this:

  • Own and continuously improve our leadership operating system and governance cadence across ExCo, XLT, leadership forums and strategic offsites.
  • Drive agenda planning, decision tracking and follow-through, ensuring clear ownership and timely escalation of risks, bottlenecks and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Lead the annual planning process together with Finance and functional leaders, translating company goals into coherent functional plans and measurable targets.
  • Track strategic priorities and value creation initiatives across the organization, creating visibility on progress, milestones, dependencies and execution risks.
  • Increase CEO effectiveness by preparing executive meetings, customer engagements, strategic discussions and leadership communications, and by coordinating resulting actions.
  • Coordinate high-quality materials, reporting and follow-up for the Board of Directors and our private equity sponsor.
  • Strengthen organizational alignment through clear executive messaging, visibility of company priorities and more efficient, AI-enabled ways of working.


Your profile

YOUR PROFILE

Must Have

  • At least 7 years of experience in business operations, executive office, transformation, program management, consulting, Chief of Staff or a comparable leadership-adjacent role.
  • A strong track record of managing complex, cross-functional initiatives and working closely with executive leadership teams.
  • Excellent planning, organizational and program management skills, combined with disciplined follow-through and a strong execution focus.
  • Strategic judgement and the ability to understand business priorities quickly, connect strategy with execution and influence without formal authority.
  • Analytical and financial fluency, including confidence working with financial models, KPI packages and board-level information.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn complex information into clear, decision-ready executive materials and presentations.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken, high ownership and sound judgement when handling confidential and sensitive information.
Nice to Have
  • Experience in a SaaS, software or technology environment.
  • Experience with Board or private equity sponsor preparation, reporting and governance.
  • Fluency in German.
  • Experience improving leadership productivity through AI-enabled tools and efficient operating rhythms.


Why us?

This is a high-impact role at the center of Matrix42's leadership and strategic execution. You will work directly with the CEO and executive team, shape how priorities become action and create the operating discipline behind our continued growth. The role offers broad exposure across the company, Board and sponsor environment, with the mandate to build alignment and make execution more effective without owning a business unit or operational function.


Our Benefits

We could tell you about the free breakfast, the drinks in the fridge, and the 30 vacation days. Or that flexible hours and remote work are part of the deal. But honestly? That's just standard.
Here's what makes working with us in Frankfurt extra special:

  • Work from (almost) anywhere - Take your job with you on a workation and get inspired by new places.
  • Time for growth - A career framework to support your professional and personal growth with up to 6 extra days off per year for your development.
  • Social Day - One paid day per year to give back: volunteer, support a cause, or attend an environmental event.
  • Bike leasing - Stay fit and sustainable. We'll handle the contract and insurance.

title: Associate Product Owner
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Glassdollar
description_html:
TL;DR

Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

The problem you'll be solvingA corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.


What we're looking for

You have personally written the tickets.
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
You are technical enough to argue with engineers.
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
You can write.
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.
You write specs worth acting on.
The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter.
You know what looks good.
You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually.
You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide.
No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec.
You want to be coached hard.
Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast.
You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day.
We want to see the workflow, not hear it described.
You want the scope to grow.
The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available.


What you'll do

Your job: turn validated opportunities into work an engineer can start on Monday.

  • Turning opportunities into scoped, sequenced, estimable work: specs, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies
  • Running the backlog: grooming, prioritisation input, keeping the board honest about what is in flight, blocked, or quietly drifting
  • Being the interface between customer signal (support threads, CS conversations, call notes) and the engineering queue
  • Coordinating releases and checking that what shipped matches what was scoped
  • Presenting product decisions to varied stakeholder groups, from engineers to enterprise clients

What you'll be scoping over your first year:
  • Deep integrations into our customers' organisations. Their systems, their data, their identity stack. This is the work that turns GlassDollar from a tool people visit into infrastructure they run on.
  • Public REST APIs and MCP servers, so our customers' engineers and their AI agents can build on top of us.
  • AI embedded across the product, inside the surfaces people already work in.
  • Workflow automation inside the platform, so the work that used to take six meetings and a shared spreadsheet runs itself.
You will need to understand each of these well enough to write the spec and defend it in the room.
This is a doing role rather than a people-management one. Mid-to-senior individual contributor.


Requirements

  • 3+ years in a product company, where you personally wrote the tickets
  • Technical enough to understand a data model, an API contract, and estimation
  • Demonstrable writing ability, be ready to share a spec, PRD or decision doc
Nice to have:
  • B2B enterprise SaaS background
  • Familiarity with venture clienting, corporate innovation, or startup-scouting workflows
  • Notion fluency

Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about the questions you ask about a brief than the answer you land on.


How we hire

Straightforward. Respectful of your time. No mystery steps.

  1. Intro call: a quick chat to see if there's a match
  2. Interview with the PM, including a brief introduction to the work sample: a spec, PRD, or decision doc where your reasoning is visible, plus examples of problems you've framed
  3. Interview
  4. Offer: if it clicks, we don't wait around

description_html:
Your mission

Deine Mission: Werde zum Wachstumsmotor von Deutschlands größter Nachbarschaftsplattform
Du willst nicht nur Media-Budgets verwalten, sondern den Markt aktiv gestalten? Du hast den Instinkt für große Deals und die Ausdauer, Marken dort zu platzieren, wo sie echtes Vertrauen genießen?
Bei nebenan.de bringen wir starke Brands direkt in das digitale Zuhause von über 4 Millionen aktiven Nutzer:innen. Wir suchen keinen "Verwalter", sondern einen Senior Sales Profi, der unser Werbegeschäft mit Biss, Kreativität und unternehmerischem Mut auf das nächste Level hebt.
Jagdinstinkt trifft Strategie

  • Pipeline-Architekt & Hunter: Du baust dir deinen eigenen Kundenstamm von Grund auf auf. Dabei nutzt du Kaltakquise als Werkzeug und identifizierst durch eigenständige Lead-Recherche – massiv unterstützt durch unsere internen KI-Tools – die Brands, die perfekt zu unserer Plattform passen
  • Deal-Closing auf Entscheiderebene: Du gewinnst große Marken und Mediaagenturen für hyperlokale und nationale Kampagnen. Du begleitest den gesamten Prozess von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum finalen Vertragsabschluss.
  • Scale bigger: Du denkst nicht in Standardpaketen. Du suchst aktiv nach Hebeln, um Budgets zu skalieren, Add-ons zu platzieren und crossmediale Konzepte umzusetzen, die nachhaltig Eindruck hinterlassen.
  • Kreativer Sparringspartner: Du entwickelst proaktiv „um die Ecke gedachte“ Ansätze für deine Kund:innen, um deren Sichtbarkeit und Wirksamkeit auf der Plattform zu maximieren.
  • Vorbild & Mentor:in: Du teilst deine Sales-Experience im Team, pushst die Ambition deiner Kolleg:innen und hilfst uns, als Einheit über uns hinauszuwachsen.


Your profile

Abschlussstärke ist deine DNA

  • Erfahrung: Du bringst 4-5+ Jahre fundierte Erfahrung im Media- oder Ad-Sales mit, idealerweise mit einem Fokus auf Branding- oder Plattformkampagnen. 
  • Erfolgsbilanz: Dein Track Record ist tadellos – du hast bereits nachweislich große Marken überzeugt und signifikante Umsatztreiber etabliert. 
  • Hunter-Mentalität: Du brennst für den Vertrieb. Kaltakquise schreckt dich nicht ab, sondern spornt dich an. Du hast den unbedingten Willen zum Erfolg und arbeitest leidenschaftlich an deinen Zielen.
  • Netzwerk: Du verfügst über ein belastbares Netzwerk in der Agentur- und Markenwelt, das du sofort aktivieren kannst.
  • Mindset: Du denkst groß und mutig. Wo andere Hindernisse sehen, findest du Wege, um das Ticket zu heben und die Idee noch stärker aufzuladen.
  • Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest selbstorganisiert, hochgradig fokussiert und mit einem echten unternehmerischen Spirit.


What we offer

  • Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit einer Kombination aus Büro- und Remote-Tagen
  • Einen sinnstiftenden Job – wir bauen ein großartiges Produkt, das echten Mehrwert für Communities liefert
  • Arbeiten in einem fröhlichen, erfahrenen Team, das Wissen teilt und voneinander lernt
  • Einblicke in den gesamten Arbeitsprozess unseres Social Startups sowie der nebenan.de Stiftung
  • Deine nebenan.de SpenditCard – jeden Monat erhältst Du zusätzlich 35 € zur freien Verfügung
  • 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, plus die Möglichkeit von Workation-Modellen und Sabbaticals
  • Eine stärkenorientierte Entwicklungskultur (wir arbeiten mit dem Gallup StrengthsFinder)
  • Ein Büro in Berlin-Kreuzberg und regelmäßige Events wie Yoga oder „Lunch & Learn“-Sessions

Wir bieten dir die Chance, in einem Umfeld zu arbeiten, das Impact mit Performance verbindet. Du gestaltest die Zukunft unseres Advertising-Geschäfts aktiv mit und profitierst von einer Plattform, die als "Zuhause für Marken mit Haltung" echtes Alleinstellungsmerkmal genießt.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Ppro
description_html:
At PPRO, we simplify access to local payments - providing a local payments platform that empowers giants like PayPal, Stripe, and Microsoft to connect with billions of consumers worldwide. We are on an ambitious, fast-paced mission to 3x our growth by 2028 - and we’re just getting started.

Our magic lies in our team of proud payments nerds. Spanning over 50 nationalities across 10+ global locations, our diverse cultures aren't a checklist; they are the competitive advantage driving our innovation. This is a people-first, high trust environment where you’ll have the autonomy to make a massive impact, own your work end-to-end, and grow through broad exposure, meaningful challenges, and continuous learning. We get things done, challenge respectfully, put the customer first, and recognise that our biggest successes are those we create as a team. If you’re ready to leave your footprint on global commerce, join us.
 
The Purpose:

Senior Fullstack Engineers (m/f/d) at PPRO drive core technical decisions, solving complex technical problems, whilst participating in decisions on architecture and technical direction. Supporting and mentoring engineering colleagues within a hands-on environment. A strong understanding of business context, customer needs, and technical constraints is essential to designing and implementing pragmatic, scalable solutions that address the right problems and deliver sustainable value.


What you’ll do:
  •  Own end-to-end software development processes, from requirements to deployment in our production systems for our key products and services (e.g. accounting and reporting systems)
  • Be an integral part of the team’s culture and ways of working, continuously improving development processes and practices together with your colleagues based on data, feedback, and changing business needs.
  • Use the latest technologies (e.g. React Query, gRPC) to solve real problems for our customers at a massive scale
  • Take e2e operational responsibility for the team-owned components
  • Share technical expertise and architect creative solutions while advancing team best practices

    • What we look for in you:
  • Ability to collaborate and grow dynamic and autonomous environments, whilst in a small, agile team.
  • Impact-oriented, collaborative, empathetic, focused, curious, well-organized, having a continuous improvement mindset and strong sense of responsibility
  • Experience leading design solutions from scratch to impact, heavily supporting them hands-on
  • Working proficiency in English
  • Confident AI-augmented development experience with a focus on a solution quality and cost-efficient usage (Ideally Claude Code)
  • Accounting/Fintech Domain: Experience with—or a strong interest in—the complexities of accounting systems or ledgers is a distinct advantage

    • Technical Requirements:
  •  5+ years of professional experience working with Java/Kotlin and JS/TS
  • Modern frameworks (Spring Boot, React)
  • Strong AWS experience, including efficient cost-management (SNS/SQS, Kinesis, Lambdas; Terraform is a plus)
  • Event-driven + Microservice architectures (Anti-corruption layer, Event Sourcing, CQRS) 
    • What's in it for you?

    Hybrid working - We offer a hybrid structure with a 3 days / week on site expectation, so you can strike the balance between office and home working. In addition to our 30-day holiday allowance, we also provide a work from abroad policy, enabling employees to work remotely for up to another 30 days per year
     
    Learning and Development - We offer a €1,000 annual budget to support your professional growth—because investing in your development benefits us all. In addition, we provide leadership cafés, on-the-job training, and other opportunities to help you grow your skills and thrive in your role.
     
    Insurance - Because better safe than sorry - we want our employees to benefit from various insurances including accident insurance, disability insurance, direct insurance (bAV) and travel insurance. 
     
    Enhance Family Leave - We understand the importance of family - that's why we offer enhanced family leave to support you during key life moments.
     
    Gym membership - PPRO helps contribute towards the costs of your gym membership, supporting your physical fitness journey while easing the burden on your wallet
     
    Mental Health Platform - We’ve teamed up with a top well-being platform to provide one-on-one therapy, chat therapy, therapist-led courses, guided meditations, and more.
     
    Our office - Located on St.-Martin-Straße, one stop from Ostbahnhof on the 3 and 7 S-lines. The office is situated in a modern and spacious building with fully multimedia-equipped meeting rooms for up to 30 people. title: AI Platform Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at CHAPTERS Group AG
description_html:
About CHAPTERS Group

CHAPTERS Group AG is a Hamburg-based holding company investing in 55+ mission-critical software companies across the DACH region, France, and the Czech Republic. Our companies deliver the digital solutions that keep the public sector and core industries running. What they do matters in daily life.

AI has rapidly disrupted the software industry, and we aim to lead that transformation across our portfolio. Central to this is the AI Core team: we build and operate a shared enterprise AI Hub used by companies across the group, and drive adoption through a network of AI Champions. Each portfolio company has one designated power user who leads AI enablement locally, runs training, and scales usage within their organisation.

Tasks

The Role

You are a core member of the AI Core team, owning the infrastructure that powers AI adoption across 55+ portfolio companies. Your focus is the AI Hub platform (Open WebUI): you keep it running, deploy new instances, build and validate integrations at HQ level, and make sure every company in the group gets a stable, well-configured environment.

We build the AI Hub as a product and support to ship it in every company. Each company owns their HUB and administers it (L1 Support). You are part of the central team that drives features and changes that are of high value for all hubs in the portfolio.

In addition, you are part of the team that serves as the center of expertise (L2 Support) and give guidance and hands-on support when the first level teams need you.

What You Will Work On

  • Platform engineering: new integrations, container images, infrastructure-as-code, deployment tooling and security patches. This is the product that every company runs
  • Release qualification: when the upstream project ships a new version, you assess it (one-way database migrations, breaking changes, patch compatibility), validate it on a canary, and publish a qualified release with notes that an L1 can act on
  • Shared infrastructure: Application Gateway, WAF policies, TLS certificates, Redis, DNS and network peering. This layer is shared across every company and cannot be devolved. A mistake here affects all of them
  • Enable the L1 network and be their technical point of contact: write the developer guides, run onboarding and office hours, and build preflight checks and guardrails that make it safe for a platform admin to deploy and operate their own Hub.
  • Integrations Catalog stewardship: versioned artefacts (tools, skills, agents, integrations) each shipped with a user guide for AI Champions and a developer guide for platform admins
  • Fleet observability: reporting and alerting version parity, uptime, cloud spend and deployment status across all companies.
  • Own the eval service: the service itself, the quality of judges and generators, and the methodology platforms use to measure whether their agents do the work
  • Close the loop. Shipping is the beginning. Your designs gather operational signals from the fleet and feed a continuous improvement cycle

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, or cloud operations, including ownership of production systems that others depend on
  • Production cloud experience on Azure or AWS
  • Infrastructure as Code in production: Bicep, Terraform, CDK or CloudFormation. We care that you think in IaC.
  • Strong Python skills beyond scripting: you have built and maintained small production services, worked with APIs, and found your way around unfamiliar codebases
  • Comfortable with Linux, Docker, Git and CI/CD as everyday working tools
  • Working knowledge of databases and identity: PostgreSQL in production, and OAuth / SSO / Entra ID concepts
  • AI-native: you use LLMs as tools, understand their operational properties, and have shipped something with them
  • English (fluent): primary working language across the team; German conversational is a plus

Bonus

  • Clear technical writing: Enabling others is a real part of this role and good documentation is part of the work rather than an afterthought
  • Experience building internal platforms or tooling used by other engineering teams
  • Working in multi-tenant or multi-customer cloud environments
  • Contributions to open-source projects, or maintaining a modified version of one in production
  • Practical experience with LLM frameworks, agents, MCP or RAG systems in production
  • French language skills: a share of our portfolio is in France and growing

Benefits

What You'll Get

  • A role that shapes the AI backbone for more than 50 software companies across Europe.
  • Become part of CHAPTERS Group, a German serial acquirer with 10x growth in the past five years and high ambitions for what comes next
  • A small, high-ownership team: decisions get made fast, your work ships to production. You are part of the CTO office with a direct line to the leadership team
  • Daily work with cutting-edge AI technologies.
  • Space to define how AI gets integrated into operational business systems at group scale: early-stage work with lasting impact across 55+ companies
  • Permanent full-time position, remote-first with the option to join the team in the Cologne office
  • A clear path to grow with us: we look for ambitious people who want to build a career, not just take a role. We actively invest in your development: talent reviews, events, conferences, etc.

How to Apply

Send your CV and answer the following questions, no formal cover letter needed:

  • Why do you find it exciting to work with vertical market software companies?
  • Why are you the right person to drive AI in the CHAPTERS Group? What is your “unfair advantage”?

We are looking forward to your application!
