title: Operations Manager, Offer Operations
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Joko
description_html:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 6 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

🦾 Our Offer Operations team

Joko helps millions of users earn cashback automatically, whether they shop online through affiliate links, activate coupons, or pay in-store with their linked bank card. Behind each of these experiences, there's an operational engine that needs to work flawlessly: transactions must be tracked, cashback must be caught, offers must be reliable, and merchants must perform as expected. When this engine breaks, users don't get paid — and trust erodes fast.

Offer Operations owns that engine. The team's mission is to guarantee the reliability and continuous improvement of Joko's core monetization mechanics — across affiliate tracking, coupons, card-linked bank integrations, gift cards, and merchant performance. It's a technical, data-heavy, high-stakes scope that sits right at the heart of what makes Joko's product work.

🎯 What you will do

As an Operations Manager, your main mission is to own one of the processes that decides whether millions of Joko users actually get the cashback they're owed. You'll report to David Le Pahun, our Offer Operations Lead. The role blends four things: analysing data, designing how the process should work, solving problems with AI, technologies or in the last resort outsourcing, and managing projects.

  • Analyse data. You'll build the dashboards that tell you — and everyone else — whether your part of the system is healthy: how many transactions are being correctly tracked and rewarded, what's silently breaking down, whether user experience is suffering.

  • Design the process. You decide how merchants get set up on our platform: their cashback rate, which purchases qualify, how we connect to their systems. A lot of this doesn't have a playbook yet — you'll be writing a good chunk of it as you go.

  • Solve problems with technology. A merchant might be showing users a coupon that doesn't actually pay out. A batch of card purchases might not match cleanly to any merchant we track. You'll dig into why, then fix it choosing the right solution for it: automating it with AI, improving one of our internal tools (built on Retool) and if a human is required, you'll build the right playbook to outsource it.

  • Manage outsourced resources. You'll manage the outsourced team members who help you operate at scale — briefing them, training them, checking their work is actually good — while juggling several of these issues at once and deciding what matters most.

  • Partner cross-functionally. With Product & Engineering when the fix is structural, and with the commercial team when it's really about a merchant relationship.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: around 2–5 years of experience, ideally with exposure to Operations, Product, or a technical/data-driven environment.

  • AI-native: you genuinely believe in what AI can do, and you already use it as part of how you work — not as a buzzword, but as a real way to automate the repetitive parts of your job and move faster on the rest.

  • Ops mindset: you think in systems — monitoring → detection → investigation → resolution → prevention. You instinctively look for what can break and build safeguards so it doesn't happen again.

  • Tech acumen: you're comfortable in a technical environment — tracking, APIs, integrations — and can hold your own in a conversation with Engineering.

  • Analytical skills: you're data-driven and comfortable navigating dashboards, investigating anomalies, and making decisions based on metrics.

  • Attention to detail: the devil is in the details, and you have a talent for spotting flaws where others don't.

  • Communication: clear written and verbal communication skills; you're not afraid to defend your decisions with demanding stakeholders (including merchants and the outsourced teams you'll be directing).

  • Education: Top-tier engineering or business school background. International experience and a double degree are a clear plus.

  • Languages: fluent in written and spoken English. Mastering French is not required.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €41.2K – €73.4K • Offers Equity

  • • €41.2K – €73.4K • Offers Equity

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Mechatronics Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and developing the hardware and software that power our automated testing and inspection platforms. Working within the R&D department, you will create robust, scalable automation tools that support both product development and manufacturing operations. Your primary focus will be mechanical development for test automation, while also collaborating on software and electrical integration aspects of test systems.

 
 

Responsibilities

  • Test Fixture Development – Design, prototype, and maintain mechanical test fixtures, jigs, and tooling built for reliability, reproducibility, and repeatable operator use.

  • Mechanical Integration – Design the physical integration of sensors, actuators, cameras, and other instruments into test stations, in collaboration with the Automation Software Engineers who own the control and software layer. Occasional software integration is also possible based on candidate skillset.

  • ATE Integration — Specify and integrate custom solutions from external vendors for testing equipment/instrumentation (RF housings, GNSS, optical systems…).

  • Cross-Team Collaboration – Work closely with product development, manufacturing, and the Infrastructure & Deployment engineer to deliver robust, maintainable, and scalable automation solutions for the factory and field.

 
 

Candidate Requirements

  • MSc in Mechanical, Mechatronics, or related engineering field.

  • Excellent CAD skills with experience in rapid prototyping and robust solution implementation (SolidWorks, Catia or similar).

  • Experience working with external vendors and machine shops for part fabrication and test equipment selection.

  • Comfortable performing soldering, wiring, and small-scale electrical circuit work for test system integration.

  • Experience working with electronic assemblies (PCBAs); familiarity with pogo-pin / bed-of-nails fixturing is a strong plus.

  • Knowledge of RF housing design and specifications is a plus.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to design practical, robust engineering solutions.

  • Excellent communication skills and proven ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.

Location and Commitments

  • Contract Type: CDI

  • Work Schedule: Full-time

  • Availability: ASAP

  • Location: Paris

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

description_html:
Join Excelya, where Audacity, Care and Energy define who we are and how we work. We believe in creating ambitious solutions and fostering an inclusive environment where collaboration and individual growth go hand in hand.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and ambitious team and contribute to a strategic enterprise-wide transformation program. As a Senior EDMS Migration Lead, you will play a key role in shaping the future document management landscape.

Key Responsabilities :

  • Lead the Document Management & Migration workstream during the feasibility phase of the program.
  • Define the end-to-end document migration strategy, including migration rules, scope, governance, and decision frameworks.
  • Develop migration roadmaps, pilot approaches, migration waves, and execution plans.
  • Build and validate migration cost models, budgets, and business case recommendations.
  • Coordinate activities across Business Process Owners, Data Analysts, Quality teams, Records Management, IT, Architecture, Procurement, and implementation partners.
  • Define migration principles covering metadata mapping, document cleansing, deduplication, transformation, reconciliation, and validation.
  • Challenge migration methodologies, estimates, and assumptions proposed by vendors and system integrators.
  • Prepare decision-making materials and recommendations for program governance committees.
  • Provide expert guidance on EDMS migrations, records management, information governance, and document lifecycle management.

Requirements

  • Master's degree or equivalent in Information Management, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Quality, or a related field.
  • Strong professional experience mainly in EDMS and Records Management, Information Governance, or Document Lifecycle Management.
  • Proven leadership of at least two large-scale document migration programs involving multiple repositories.
  • Strong experience building migration strategies, budgets, resource models, pilot plans, and migration roadmaps.
  • Hands-on experience with platforms such as Documentum, OpenText, Veeva QualityDocs, SharePoint, or similar enterprise repositories.
  • Experience within pharmaceutical, life sciences, medical device, or highly regulated industries.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and presentation skills.
  • Fluent English.

Benefits

Why join us?

At Excelya, we combine a passion for science with the enthusiasm of teamwork to redefine excellence in healthcare.

Here's what makes us unique:

We are a young and ambitious healthcare company, bringing together 900 Excelyates, driven by the goal of becoming the leading mid-sized CRO in Europe, while offering the best employee experience.

Our "one-stop provider" service model—combining full-service, functional service provider, and consulting—allows you to grow through diverse and stimulating projects. By collaborating with leading experts, you will contribute to the development of scientific, operational, and human knowledge, all in service of improving the patient journey.

Excelling with kindness means evolving in an environment that values ​​your natural talents, encourages boldness, pushes boundaries, and cultivates your potential, so that you can fully contribute to our shared mission.

title: Product Analyst
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Accurx
description_html:
London/Hybrid

£40,000 - £60,000 + share options up to £14,500 + Benefits

💬 Accurx is where conversations happen with and about patients.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. We’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that connects everyone through communication.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book, which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

The team

We have a massive vision and even more ideas, but right now, our ambitions are outstripping our capacity. That’s where you come in. We aren't looking for someone to just "run the reports" we’re looking for a foundational member of a growing function who is excited to help us redefine how data influences product.

At Accurx, we don't just wait for a roadmap to be handed down; we expect everyone to help shape it. While you'll be part of a team of expert data and product leaders, you'll be the one in the driver's seat for your domain. You won't be watching from the sidelines - you'll be proactively hunting for insights, challenging our current assumptions, and taking ownership of how data can save clinician time from day one. This is a role for a critical thinker who is energised by the "blank canvas" of a growing function and has the drive to turn raw data into a better reality for millions of patients.

Challenges you’ll solve...

  • You will steer product strategy by partnering with Product Managers to define what success looks like and by monitoring the KPIs that prove our impact on the frontline of healthcare.

  • You will interrogate user behaviour by performing deep-dive analyses that look past the surface to find the "why," ensuring we’re solving the right problems for the right people.

  • You will lead rigorous experiments by helping design and run A/B tests, owning the process from the initial hypothesis through to the final, data-backed recommendation.

  • You will build the engine for self-service insights by creating the dashboards and visualisations that ensure your pod has high-quality data at their fingertips to move fast.


You should apply if...

  • You've worked within a product team environment (not just as a standalone data or BI function), partnering directly with Product Managers, Engineers, and Designers on live product decisions, not just reporting on outcomes after the fact.

  • You are a proactive investigator who doesn't need a ticket to start digging; when things are quiet, you’re already looking for the next trend or bottleneck that we’ve missed.

  • You have a "get stuck in" mindset - you’re excited by a lean environment where you can build your own processes and take on challenges that push you outside your comfort zone.

  • You bring strong Product Thinking with an understanding of user funnels and a hunger to master metrics like activation, retention, and cohort behaviour.

  • You are sharpening a strong technical toolkit, with a solid command of SQL and the ambition to use Python.

  • You are a delivery-focused collaborator who thrives in agile environments and knows how to communicate technical findings clearly to engineers and designers.

  • You’ve used tools like Mixpanel or Amplitude and are ready to become a power user who empowers the whole team through effective data storytelling.

What’s in it for me?

You'll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we're led by our Principles and our mission to Fix Healthcare Communication

  • £40,000 - £60,000 salary + share options up to £14,500

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Flexible working: We are an office first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office 3 days a week, with core hours of 10am - 4pm

  • Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

  • Family matters: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

  • We have our very own Chef! Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches will be provided, with the occasional sweet treat!

Compensation: £40K – £60K • Offers Equity

salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Accurx
description_html:
Accurx is where conversations happen with and about patients in the NHS

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that connects everyone through communication.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient, has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices and 68% (and growing!) of NHS Trusts.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book that lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.


Gamechanging, right? Here's what you'll be getting stuck into to make it work

As an Implementation Manager, you’ll be the one making sure our most ambitious tools actually land and stick in Secondary care. You won't just be ticking boxes on a rollout list; you’ll be leading the charge on high-impact transformations, like helping clinicians and admin teams move over to Accurx Scribe. You'll spend your time figuring out how these tools fit into the daily lives of clinicians, making sure they aren't just "installed," but are genuinely making things better for everyone.

  • Driving deep transformation: Leading big-scale rollouts for complex products like Scribe, making sure we’re not just doing the basics but fundamentally changing how healthcare is delivered.

  • Strategic boundary-setting: Standing firm on implementation plans and managing commercial expectations to ensure we deliver sustainable solutions without overcommitting.

  • Owning the AI journey: Becoming the go-to expert on our emerging AI features, taking full ownership of how they are introduced to practices and scaled across the country.

  • Closing the feedback loop: Reviewing practice cohorts 6-9 months after go-live to see if they’re actually using the product as intended and figuring out how we can make it even better.

  • Scaling with smarts: Using our internal AI dashboards to handle the "heavy lifting" of data, so you can focus on the human side of implementation while we automate the repetitive bits.

  • Raising the bar: Constantly looking for ways to improve our processes—if something isn't working or could be more efficient, you’ll have the autonomy to change it.

 

You should apply if...

  • You’ve been around the block with big rollouts: You have solid experience managing complex implementations in a fast-paced business and you know how to keep a project moving.

  • You’re a "driver," not a "passenger": You don't wait to be told what to do; you dive into the context, spot the problems, and take the lead on solving them.

  • You can hold your own: You’re comfortable having tough conversations with stakeholders and can stay firm on what’s achievable

  • You’re a natural communicator: You can explain technical or complex changes in a way that feels clear, simple, and actually exciting for the people using them.

  • You’re relentlessly resourceful: When you hit a roadblock, you don't just stop - you find a creative way over, under, or through it.

  • You care about the "why": You’re motivated by the idea of fixing healthcare communication and want to see the real-world impact of your work on clinicians and patients.

What’s in it for me?

You'll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we're led by our Principles and our mission to Solve Healthcare Productivity.

  • £45,000 - £60,000 salary + share options up to £15,000

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Flexible Working: We are an office first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office 3 days a week, with core hours of 10am-4pm

  • Family matters: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

  • We have our very own Chef! Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches will be provided, with the occasional sweet treat!

Find us across social media: Medium, LinkedIn, X, Instagram and YouTube.

  • Demo-ing the full functionality of Accurx products: our products are updated regularly, so ensuring you’re fully up to speed on what’s new and what’s coming for our users is essential

About the Job

What You'll Be Doing

title: Senior Financial Accountant - FTC 12 months
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Zilch
description_html:
Who we are:

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay.

We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers.

 

Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us?

About the role.

The Senior Financial Accountant is responsible for key areas of Zilch’s month-end close, financial reporting and operational expenditure accounting. The role operates with a high degree of independence, ensuring financial information is accurate, complete and delivered in line with reporting deadlines and control requirements.

The role requires the individual to resolve complex accounting and operational issues, determine appropriate approaches to new or ambiguous assignments, and identify improvements to Finance processes, systems and controls. The Senior Financial Accountant works closely with colleagues across Finance and the wider business, contributes to cross-functional initiatives and supports the development of junior team members.

Day-to-day responsibilities.

  • Own relevant areas of the monthly management accounts across the P&L and balance sheet, ensuring accurate and timely reporting.

  • Take end-to-end responsibility for operational expenditure accounting and the accruals process, ensuring costs are complete, accurate and appropriately recognised.

  • Partner with FP&A on operational expenditure, explaining performance against budget, investigating variances and providing meaningful commentary and insight.

  • Own specified non-Opex accounting areas, including IFRS 16 lease accounting, advertising revenue and customer acquisition costs.

  • Work with Sales, Growth and other stakeholders to obtain the information required for accurate accounting and determine the appropriate accounting treatment.

  • Own the Finance relationship for Zilch’s Polish subsidiary, working with the local Finance team and external accountants to review the monthly trial balance and supporting reconciliations.

  • Resolve subsidiary accounting queries and oversee management and statutory reporting activities to support accurate and timely consolidation into Group reporting.

  • Prepare and review month-end journals, including accruals, prepayments and fixed assets, in accordance with reporting deadlines and financial controls.

  • Complete and review detailed balance sheet reconciliations, proactively investigating and resolving discrepancies.

  • Provide clear financial commentary, variance analysis and insight to Finance and non-Finance stakeholders.

  • Support the preparation of year-end accounts and completion of the external audit, independently resolving matters within the role’s areas of ownership and escalating more complex issues appropriately.

  • Provide guidance to the AP and AR function, supported by analysis of ageing, expenditure and other relevant trends.

  • Identify risks, control gaps and opportunities to improve Finance processes, systems and ways of working.

  • Define and implement practical improvements that increase the accuracy, efficiency and scalability of Finance operations.

  • Contribute to the continued development and optimisation of NetSuite, working with internal stakeholders and Oracle consultants to define requirements, assess options and support implementation.

  • Determine the appropriate approach for new or ambiguous assignments, presenting options and recommending practical solutions where established procedures do not fully address the issue.

  • Support medium to large Finance projects and cross-functional initiatives, taking ownership of defined workstreams of low to medium complexity.

  • Manage competing priorities and deliver accurate work against key reporting and project deadlines with minimal oversight.

  • Build effective relationships across Finance and the wider business, adapting communication and working styles to different stakeholders.

  • Simplify complex financial or technical information and communicate it clearly to Finance and non-Finance audiences.

  • Lead knowledge-sharing within relevant stakeholder groups and provide guidance and coaching to junior colleagues.

  • Ensure the role’s priorities and outputs remain aligned with Finance priorities, Zilch’s wider objectives and company performance.

What we're looking for...

  • A recognised professional accounting qualification, such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent, with typically at least two years of relevant post-qualification experience.

  • Broad technical accounting knowledge and the ability to apply it independently to operational and financial reporting matters.

  • Practical experience of month-end close, management accounts preparation and balance sheet reporting in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong knowledge of accruals, prepayments, fixed assets and operational expenditure accounting.

  • Experience of IFRS 16 lease accounting and the ability to assess accounting treatments for less routine transactions.

  • Experience preparing and reviewing journals, reconciliations, supporting analysis and financial commentary.

  • Experience supporting year-end statutory accounts and external audit requirements.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate issues, identify risks, evaluate options and recommend solutions.

  • Advanced Excel skills and the ability to interpret financial data, identify trends and communicate meaningful insights.

  • Experience using NetSuite is desirable, alongside the ability to navigate and improve financial systems, processes and cross-functional workflows.

  • Experience partnering with FP&A and non-Finance stakeholders to understand business activity and its financial impact.

  • Experience working with international subsidiaries, local Finance teams or external accounting providers is desirable.

  • A solid understanding of Zilch’s operating model and how Finance activities contribute to company objectives and performance measures.

  • Awareness of relevant industry developments, regulatory requirements, financial tools and emerging practices, with the ability to apply this knowledge to the role.

  • An understanding of the customer, competitive and market factors that may affect Zilch and the role’s areas of responsibility.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to make complex financial information accessible and relevant to different audiences.

  • The ability to work independently across complex operational responsibilities, applying sound judgement when information is incomplete or issues are ambiguous.

  • Experience sharing specialist knowledge and coaching or supporting the development of junior colleagues.

Benefits.

Compensation & Savings:

  • Pension scheme.

  • Death in Service scheme.

  • Income Protection.

  • 5% back on in-app purchases.

  • £200 for WFH Setup.

Health & Wellbeing:

  • Private Medical Insurance including;

  • GP consultations (video, telephone or face-to-face).

  • Prescribed medication.

  • In-patient, day-patient and out-patient care.

  • Mental health support.

  • Optical, dental & audiological cover.

  • Physiotherapy.

  • Advanced cancer cover.

  • Menopause support.

  • Employee Assistance Programme including:

    • Unlimited mental health sessions.

    • 24/7 remote GP & physiotherapy.

    • 24/7 helpline for emotional & practical support.

  • Savings & discounts on everyday shopping.

  • 1:1 personalised well-being consultations.

  • Gym membership discounts.

Family Friendly Policies:

  • Enhanced maternity pay.

  • Enhanced paternity pay.

  • Enhanced adoption pay.

  • Enhanced shared parental leave.

Learning & Development:

  • Professional Qualifications.

  • Professional Memberships.

  • Learning Suite for e-courses.

  • Internal Training Programmes.

  • FCA & Regulatory training.

Workplace Perks:

  • Hybrid working: office-based Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday; remote working Tuesday and Friday

  • Casual dress code.

  • Workplace socials.

  • Healthy snacks.

About Airspeed

Airspeed is AI revenue execution. We connect signals across CRM, calls, Slack, and product systems. Our agents flag deal risk early and help teams act. They coach reps, manage follow-ups, update the CRM, and identify likely slips.


Founded by former DeepMind researchers, Airspeed now supports hundreds of revenue teams, including Persona, Menlo Security, Pricefx, and Wayflyer. We are a Series A company with approximately 40 people across London, New York, San Francisco, and Boston.

The Opportunity

We are hiring an Operations Associate to serve as a critical operational backbone for our fast-growing GTM team and manage our central London hub.


This is a dynamic, multi-faceted role for a proactive problem-solver who enjoys working across data, technology, project management, and day-to-day office operations. You will sit at the intersection of revenue operations, business operations, and local team enablement—ensuring our GTM processes run cleanly while maintaining a great working environment in our UK office.
You will work closely with our VP of GTM Strategy & Operations and cross-functional leaders, gaining direct exposure to how a high-growth AI company scales its commercial engine and internal infrastructure.

What You Will Own

GTM & Revenue Operations Support:

  • Data Quality & Hygiene: Maintain high data integrity by executing data cleaning and deduplication across multiple platforms, including Clay and HubSpot.

  • Front-Line Tech Support: Serve as the primary Slack support contact for our GTM team, troubleshooting day-to-day tech issues and tool workflows.

  • Special Projects: Partner directly with the VP of GTM Strategy & Operations on high-priority initiatives across business operations, finance operations, revenue operations, and ad-hoc commercial tasks.

Project Management & Execution:

  • Keep cross-functional projects on track by coordinating stakeholder teams, monitoring milestones, and ensuring clear communication across dependencies.

  • Document lightweight operational processes to help the team scale efficiently.

London Office Management:

  • Own the day-to-day operations of the UK office in London, ensuring the space is always fully stocked, organized, well-maintained, and set up for team success.

  • Coordinate local vendor relationships, supplies, and office logistics to foster an inviting, productive workplace.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first several quarters:

  • Our CRM and GTM platforms (HubSpot, Clay) maintain a high bar of data accuracy and cleanliness.

  • Day-to-day GTM tool issues are resolved quickly on Slack, keeping revenue reps focused on selling.

  • Cross-functional projects driven by GTM Strategy & Operations land on time with clear stakeholder alignment.

  • The London office runs seamlessly as a functional, vibrant hub for the local team and visiting colleagues.

What We Are Looking For

  • Operational Drive: Proven ability to manage multiple distinct workstreams—from data tasks to office logistics—with high attention to detail and follow-through.

  • Tech-Savvy & Adaptable: Comfort working with or learning GTM tools. Direct experience with Clay, HubSpot, Airspeed, Nooks, or Alguna is a plus, but not required—we will train you up on all these platforms.

  • Data Hygiene Mindset: Systematic approach to organizing, cleaning, and verifying data across different software platforms.

  • Stakeholder Coordination: Strong communication skills with the ability to keep project teams aligned, accountable, and moving forward.

  • Problem-Solving Orientation: A helpful, service-oriented attitude when supporting colleagues via Slack or resolving office challenges.

  • Builder Mindset: High ownership and flexibility to adapt as priorities shift in a fast-paced Series A environment.

Why Join Airspeed

  • Gain broad, hands-on exposure to strategy, finance, and revenue operations in a fast-scaling AI business.

  • Work directly with senior leadership, including the VP of GTM Strategy & Operations.

  • Enjoy a high-visibility role where your work directly impacts team productivity and office culture.

  • Master modern GTM tools and AI-native operational workflows.

  • Join an international SaaS company at an exciting stage of growth.

How to Apply

Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile together with a short note sharing an example of an operational challenge or project you successfully managed. Tell us what the issue was, how you handled it, and the outcome.

description_html:
Voleon is a technology company that applies state-of-the-art AI and machine learning techniques to real-world problems in finance. For nearly two decades, we have led our industry and worked at the frontier of applying AI/ML to investment management. We have become a multibillion-dollar asset manager, and we have ambitious goals for the future.

Your colleagues will include internationally recognized experts in artificial intelligence and machine learning research as well as highly experienced finance and technology professionals. In addition to our enriching and collegial working environment, we offer highly competitive compensation and benefits packages, technology talks by our experts, a beautiful modern office, daily catered lunches, and more.

The Trading Operations group at Voleon sits at the crossroads of finance and applied science, collaborating with research and other production staff to supervise and improve systematic trading strategies.  The team ensures that the outputs of our research efforts are successfully implemented in the real world.  Domains of contribution include algorithmic execution, securities lending, and market expertise across a variety of asset classes and markets. 

As an Associate Member of Trading Staff, you will rotate across our credit, equity, forex, and derivatives desks to learn each asset class and region we trade, and eventually assume ownership of our systematic trading programs.  You will directly interact with both internal stakeholders and the broker dealer community.  The collaboration and rotation amongst the team will enable you to become an expert in market microstructure and trading operations.  Under mentorship from senior traders, you will build analytics and automation that enhance the level of sophistication and scale at which the firmwide trading program operates. 

Responsibilities

  • Monitor high-volume execution algorithms and portfolio risk

  • Track real-time market developments

  • Interface with external brokers and trading counterparties

  • Contribute to the codebase underlying automated trading operations

  • Build processes and technology to prevent errors or outages while increasing team capacity

  • Provide insight and expertise to the research and development staff

  • Work global market hours for a portion of every year on a rotational basis

Requirements

  • Demonstrated passion for markets

  • Proficiency in a programming language like Python or R

  • Experience using a Unix-like OS

  • Academic or practical familiarity with statistics

  • A skillset in data analysis and visualization

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific or quantitative discipline

  • Attention to detail and clarity of thought

title: Senior V&V Systems Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Hypersonica
description_html:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
 
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do

  • Own the system architecture and system model for Hypersonica’s high‑speed flight vehicles, ensuring mission intent, vehicle dynamics, avionics, and GNC form a coherent, verifiable whole. 

  • Lead aerospace systems architecture design, taking responsibility for how the vehicle is defined across disciplines from early concept through Preliminary Design Review (PDR) and beyond. 

  • Build and maintain the authoritative system requirements model, decomposing mission‑level objectives into clear, testable system and sub‑system requirements. 

  • Define and own the end‑to‑end system V‑model, including requirements validation, verification strategy, and clear readiness gates for Kick‑off and PDR. 

  • Apply model‑based systems engineering (MBSE) as a practical engineering tool, not a documentation exercise, ensuring traceability between requirements, models, analyses, and tests. 

  • Develop and deliver a 6‑DoF Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) model to PDR standard, in close collaboration with flight physics and avionics engineers. 

  • Apply closed‑loop control theory in the context of high‑speed flight and military guidance, ensuring controllability, stability, and performance are understood at the system level. 

  • Integrate vehicle dynamics, control laws, sensors, and actuators into a coherent closed‑loop system representation. 

  • Identify system‑level risks early particularly around requirements gaps, controllability, observability, and verification — and drive mitigations decisively. 

  • Act as a technical authority across disciplines, keeping architectural decisions coherent as designs evolve at pace. 


Who you are

  • An experienced Systems Engineer with a strong track record in system architecture, requirements decomposition, and delivery in safety‑ or mission‑critical environments. 

  • Deeply fluent in model‑based systems engineering, with practical experience owning requirements models and using MBSE to drive real engineering decisions. 

  • Strong grounding in closed‑loop control theory, applied to high‑speed flight, guidance, and defence or military systems. 

  • Comfortable developing and working with 6‑DoF flight and GNC models, and understanding their implications at vehicle level. 

  • Experienced taking systems through early design gates (Kick‑off, PDR), not just theoretical or paper studies. 

  • Someone who thinks in system behaviours, interfaces, and failure modes, not isolated components. 

  • Confident operating in ambiguous, fast‑moving environments where decisions must be made with incomplete data. 

  • Technically credible across disciplines, able to challenge assumptions and close decisions without consensus theatre. 

  • Motivated by working on systems where performance, robustness, and national‑level impact genuinely matter. 


Security and Elgibility Requirement
Due to the nature of the work with the UK MOD, applicants must be a British Citizen (or Dual UK national with British citizenship) and eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and, where required, Developed Vetting (DV) 

What we offer

  • A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. 

  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow. 

  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. 

  • A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions. 

  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. 

  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. 

At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.
 
Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
 
You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

title: Fullstack Engineer - Subscriptions
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Spotify
description_html:
The Subscriptions Mission is shaping the future of how millions of people discover, purchase, and experience Spotify Premium. We build the platforms and tools that power Spotify's global subscription business, enabling new offers, pricing strategies, and commerce experiences that help our business move quickly while delivering exceptional experiences for listeners.

Join the Monaco squad, where we create the internal products that enable Spotify teams to launch, configure, and manage Premium offers with confidence. From subscriptions and prepaid products to pricing updates and promotional campaigns, our tools support business-critical operations through intuitive experiences, trusted workflows, and reliable platform services.

As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll develop end-to-end solutions spanning modern web applications, backend services, and data platforms. Working closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and business partners, you'll help create the tools that enable Spotify's global subscription business to innovate safely, efficiently, and at scale.


What You'll Do

  • Build end-to-end features across modern web applications, backend services, and data platforms that support Spotify's global subscription business.

  • Create intuitive internal products that enable business teams to launch, configure, and manage Premium offers through secure, guided workflows.

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services that power subscriptions, prepaid products, pricing, promotions, and the offer lifecycle.

  • Develop GraphQL and gRPC APIs that connect frontend applications with distributed platform services.

  • Design efficient database schemas, implement data migrations, and optimize application performance using PostgreSQL.

  • Build secure, reliable, and auditable systems that support business-critical financial operations and SOX-compliant approval workflows.

  • Collaborate with engineers across the Subscriptions Mission to evolve shared platform capabilities, improve developer experience, and increase platform reliability.

  • Write maintainable, well-tested code while contributing to technical design, architecture discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to help maintain the reliability and availability of services powering Spotify Premium.


    • Who You Are

  • You have experience building and delivering production software across both frontend and backend technologies.

  • You have experience developing scalable backend services using modern Java, with Java 17+ experience being a plus.

  • You have built modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and Next.js.

  • You have experience designing or consuming GraphQL APIs and enjoy building schema-driven applications.

  • You have worked with gRPC services and Protocol Buffers, or you're excited to deepen your expertise in distributed systems.

  • You have hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database, including schema design, migrations, and query optimization.

  • You care about writing reliable, maintainable, and well-tested software that delivers long-term value.

  • You enjoy partnering with engineers, designers, product managers, and business stakeholders to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful outcomes.

  • You have a passion for simplifying complex workflows and creating intuitive experiences for internal users.

  • Experience with tools such as jOOQ, Flyway, Apollo GraphQL, DataLoader, Styled Components, Storybook, TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS, Material UI, or similar technologies will help you ramp up quickly.

  • Experience building commerce platforms, subscription products, pricing systems, distributed systems, or large-scale platform modernization initiatives is beneficial.


    • Where You'll Be

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the EMEA region as long as we have a work location.

  • This team operates within the Central European and GMT time zones for collaboration.

    • Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
     
    At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

  • Background in commercial, retail, or real estate development environments (e.g., flexible office, commercial fit-outs, retail spaces).

title: Coding Tutor/Lehrkraft (all genders)

description_html:
Du hast in der Softwareentwicklung mit Python gearbeitet – Code geschrieben, Anwendungen automatisiert, vielleicht sogar objektorientiert entwickelt – und willst dieses Wissen jetzt weitergeben, statt es nur für eigene Projekte zu nutzen? Als Python-Tutor/Lehrkraft begleitest Du unsere Teilnehmenden fachlich und didaktisch durch ihre Programmier-Weiterbildung: Du beantwortest ihre Fragen, hilfst ihnen über die Hürden bei Übungen und Projekten hinweg und sorgst dafür, dass sie am Ende nicht nur Python verstehen, sondern selbstständig damit arbeiten können.

Du bewertest Lernfortschritte, führst Abschlussprüfungen durch und gibst strukturiertes, konstruktives Feedback. Durch den engen Kontakt zu den Lernenden trägst Du außerdem aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Trainingsprogramme bei – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Coaching Team Lead, dem Learning Team und weiteren Schnittstellen.

Schwerpunkte Deiner Rolle

  • Fachliche Beantwortung von Fragen der Lernenden (schriftlich und mündlich)

  • Vermittlung und Vertiefung von Trainingsinhalten in Live-Sessions, Webinaren, Classrooms und individueller Lernbegleitung

  • Begleitung bei Unsicherheiten im Lernprozess sowie in Übungen und Projekten

  • Durchführung und Bewertung von Abschlussprüfungen sowie Entscheidung über den Trainingserfolg

  • Erstellung, Aufbereitung und Weiterentwicklung von Lernmaterialien rund um objektorientierte Programmierung, Python, Jupyter Notebooks, Entwicklungsumgebungen (z. B. VS Code), Git, Bash/Scripting sowie GenAI-Tools; Kenntnisse in SQL sind ein Plus

  • Qualitätssicherung bestehender Trainings inkl. Feedback ans Learning-Team

  • Durchführung individueller Coaching-Sessions und Unterstützung neuer Teammitglieder

Das bringst Du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik oder eines fach verwandten Bereichs oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Praxiskenntnisse in Softwareentwicklung (z. B. Webentwicklung, Datenverarbeitung, Automatisierung) sowie Kenntnisse in objektorientierter Programmierung

  • Sehr gute Programmierfähigkeiten in Python, Vertrautheit im Umgang mit Jupyter Notebooks und IDEs (z. B. VS Code) sowie gute Praxiskenntnisse in Bash/Scripting

  • Erfahrung mit Versionskontrolle (Git/GitHub) und gängigen Entwicklungsumgebungen

  • SQL-Kenntnisse sowie Erfahrung im Einsatz von GenAI-Tools sind von Vorteil

  • Didaktische Erfahrung in der Vermittlung technischer oder fachlicher Inhalte an nicht-technische Zielgruppen

  • Verständnis für didaktische Konzepte der Erwachsenenbildung und Online-Weiterbildung

  • Kenntnisse in Python, SQL, Power BI oder Excel sind ein Plus

  • Hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung, Empathie, klare Kommunikation und konstruktive Feedbackkultur

  • Hands-on-Mentalität, Teamgeist, Belastbarkeit und Flexibilität

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1)

 

Das bieten wir Dir

Arbeitskultur
Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.

Ownership
Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Workation
Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

Raum für Austausch
Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

Weiterentwicklung
Absolviere unsere Online-Trainings, um Deine fachlichen Fähigkeiten auszubauen und Dich zur Expert:in für Daten und KI zu entwickeln.

title: Analytics Engineer - Marketing & Growth

description_html:
Senior Analytics Engineer Marketing & Growth : You will own and architect the systems and definitions that determine how every euro of marketing spend is measured, audited, and optimized. Your work will directly shape how we understand acquisition performance, allocate budgets, and scale efficiently across markets. You will join a lean, 4 person team working on mission-critical initiatives in a fast-growing, design-driven environment.

At PERGOLUX, we value integrity, innovation, ambition, and unity — and we build systems with the same care and precision as our products.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and own the Single Source of Truth for Marketing and Storefront, defining CAC, Engagement, and core performance metrics with clarity, consistency, and auditability.

  • Implement Multi-Touch Attribution models and lay the groundwork for Marketing Mix Models that inform budget allocation and channel-level investment.

  • Expand Semantic model with relevant context and metrics that enables conversational analytics and shortens the time to insight

  • Design and build Data Health metrics that bring visibility to the quality, accuracy, freshness and completeness of our marketing and storefront data

  • Partner closely with marketing, storefront, and leadership stakeholders to drive faster, smarter decisions.

What You’ll Bring

  • Minimum 5 years experience in analytics engineering roles

  • A strong, proactive ownership mindset with the confidence to challenge requests that introduce ambiguity, technical debt, or low business impact.

  • Expert proficiency in SQL, dbt, and data modeling, with experience building durable, modular systems that scale with the business. (Stack: Airbyte, Python, Snowflake, Looker)

  • Prior experience building Multi-touch Attribution Models or Marketing Mix Models (MMM)

  • Deep understanding of marketing analytics concepts, including ROAS, CPA, MER, attribution logic, CRM data structures, and channel mechanics.

  • Professional working proficiency in English, enabling clear communication in an international, cross-functional environment.

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary & Bonus Structure – Your success is rewarded with strong compensation and performance-based bonuses.

  • Real Ownership – Take meaningful responsibility in your role and directly influence key business outcomes.

  • International Team – Collaborate with passionate colleagues across Europe, gaining exposure to diverse perspectives and ideas.

  • Outdoor Lifestyle Discounts – Enjoy exclusive discounts on PERGOLUX products.

  • Fast-Track Career Opportunities – As we scale quickly, you’ll have significant opportunities to grow into senior leadership roles.

  • Team Culture – Be part of regular team events, retreats, and a culture that celebrates wins—big and small.

  • Bike Leasing Program – Benefit from a sustainable and cost-effective bike leasing option to support commuting and an active lifestyle.

How to Apply

If you’re excited to build high-impact data systems at the core of a fast-scaling global brand, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply via PERGOLUX LinkedIn or through our PERGOLUX Career Page

title: Sales Manager – SaaS/B2B (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at plancraft
description_html:
UNSER PURPOSE BEI PLANCRAFT

Gemeinsam das Rückgrat des europäischen Handwerks aufbauen – mit moderner Software und smarten AI-Lösungen.
Wir entwickeln nicht einfach nur Software – wir haben die Mission, Handwerkerinnen und Handwerksbetrieben mehr Raum zu schaffen, indem wir sie mit einer praxisnahen SaaS-Lösung ausstatten, die so arbeitet wie sie: schnell, effizient und ohne unnötigen Admin-Aufwand. Unterstützt durch smarte AI-Funktionen genau dort, wo sie im Alltag wirklich helfen. Mit Tier 1 Investoren aus Europa und den USA wie Headline und Creandum sowie über 30.000 Handwerkerinnen als Kundenbasis skalieren wir europaweit, um aus einzelnen, verstreuten Betrieben vernetzte und erfolgreiche Communities zu machen.
Wir glauben an zero admin, nicht zero personality – und wir entwickeln jede Funktion mit den Menschen im Blick, die die Sicherheitsschuhe tragen, nicht die Anzüge. Wir haben Bock, die Zukunft zu gestalten, zusammen als Team, und sind bodenständig in unserer Mission, die Macherinnen von morgen zu unterstützen.

DEINE MISSION BEI UNS

 

Als Sales Manager (f/m/d) bist du ein zentraler Treiber des Umsatzwachstums bei plancraft. Du arbeitest mit qualifizierten, eingehenden Leads und begleitest sie vom ersten Gespräch bis zum Vertragsabschluss.



Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Du bearbeitest qualifizierte Leads mit erkennbarem Bedarf.

  • Du führst Produktdemos durch, analysierst Kundenbedürfnisse und entwickelst passende Lösungen.

  • Du berätst potenzielle Kund:innen strukturiert und begleitest sie durch den gesamten Verkaufsprozess.

  • Du schließt Deals eigenständig ab – vom Erstgespräch bis zum Vertragsabschluss.

  • Du behältst deine KPIs im Blick und arbeitest strukturiert mit unserem CRM.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing und Customer Success zusammen, um die bestmögliche Kundenerfahrung zu schaffen.

Bei plancraft erwarten dich klare und transparente Karrierepfade – z. B. von Junior Sales Manager bis Senior Sales Manager – und du kannst dich bei uns mit klarer Perspektive und nachhaltig weiterentwickeln. Unsere Gehaltsstruktur ist transparent aufgebaut: Je nach Erfahrungslevel liegt dein On-Target-Earnings (OTE) zwischen 60.000 € und 87.500 €, bestehend aus einem Fixgehalt zwischen 45.000 € und 62.500 € sowie einer variablen Komponente zwischen 15.000 € und 25.000 €.

 

DEIN PROFIL

 

Must-haves

  • Erste Erfahrung im B2B- oder SaaS-Vertrieb, idealerweise im Umgang mit warmen Leads oder Closing.

  • Erfahrung in der Bedarfsanalyse und im Führen strukturierter Verkaufsgespräche.

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen (z. B. HubSpot, Pipedrive oder Salesforce).

  • Interesse daran, AI zu nutzen, um deinen Sales-Alltag smarter, skalierbarer und wirkungsvoller zu gestalten.

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C1/C2-Niveau.

  • Offenheit, regelmäßig in unser Büro in Hamburg zu kommen (hybrid).



Nice-to-Haves

  • Erfahrung im SaaS-Vertrieb.

  • Erfahrung mit Kund:innen aus dem Handwerks- oder Baugewerbe.

 

WARUM PLANCRAFT?

 

  • Team Spirit: Mit Leidenschaft, Engagement und echtem Bock setzen wir alles daran, unsere Mission gemeinsam zu verwirklichen. Team Spirit feiern wir regelmäßig: mit 3 großen Team Events im Jahr, 2 monatlichen lockeren Formaten in unserem HQ und einer starken Recognition Culture, in der wir kleine wie große Erfolge sichtbar machen und gemeinsam zelebrieren.

  • Ownership: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung ab Tag eins. In einem Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und hohem Vertrauen kannst du wirklich etwas bewegen.

  • Weiterentwicklung: Wir investieren gezielt in deine Entwicklung – durch eine starke Feedback Kultur, ein persönliches Learning Budget und Enablement Formate. Wir wollen dich bestmöglich unterstützen, damit du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst.

  • AI Enablement: Unsere internen Tools und Workflows sind von Grund auf KI-gestützt konzipiert. Wir unterstützen jedes Team und jede einzelne Person dabei, KI im Arbeitsalltag auf dem nächsten Level einzusetzen – inklusive einer eigenen ChatGPT+-Lizenz, selbstverständlich.

  • Tech & Tooling: Du bekommst moderne Hardware wie ein MacBook und hochwertige Over Ear Kopfhörer sowie alle Tools, die du für dein Daily Doing brauchst.

  • Flexibilität: Ob remote, hybrid oder im Office: Du arbeitest dort, wo du es am besten kannst. Unser Hamburger Büro am Rödingsmarkt (inkl. Dachterrasse) steht dir jederzeit offen.

  • Erholung: 30 Urlaubstage, der 24.12. frei, ein Zuschuss zum Urban Sports Club sowie interne Sport Meetups unterstützen dich beim Abschalten.

  • Mobilität: Du kannst dir ein JobRad holen oder ein bezuschusstes Deutschlandticket bzw. eine BahnCard nutzen.

  • Internationales Umfeld: Wir werden stetig internationaler mit Kolleginnen u. a. in Italien, Frankreich, den Niederlanden und Österreich – und kommunizieren intern auf Englisch.

title: Working Student (all genders) – Robust Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction for Dynamic Scene
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Xitaso
description_html:
Abstract

Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models can recover scene geometry directly from images or videos without costly scene-specific optimization. By combining large-scale pre-training, multi-view reasoning, and strong geometric priors, these models provide an efficient alternative to traditional reconstruction pipelines such as Structure-from-Motion, NeRF, and optimization-based 3D Gaussian Splatting.

Despite recent progress, current models remain sensitive to challenging real-world conditions. Occlusions, moving objects, illumination changes, nighttime scenes, reflections, rain, fog, and snow can result in incomplete geometry, unreliable correspondences, and temporally inconsistent predictions. Improving robustness under such conditions is essential for autonomous driving and robotic perception.

As a working student, you will support the development of robust feed-forward reconstruction models for dynamic scenes. You will investigate methods for handling occlusion, changing illumination, and adverse weather, and explore how large reconstruction models can serve as general-purpose geometric backbones for downstream 3D scene understanding, particularly semantic occupancy prediction and 4D occupancy forecasting.


These tasks interest you

  • Develop and evaluate feed-forward 3D reconstruction models for dynamic scenes using monocular or multi-view image sequences.
  • Investigate reconstruction robustness under partial and long-term occlusions, moving objects, and incomplete observations.
  • Develop methods to improve geometric consistency under illumination changes, low-light conditions, shadows, and reflections.
  • Evaluate and improve model performance under adverse weather conditions such as rain, fog, snow, and reduced visibility.
  • Compare the developed methods with relevant baselines and document technical and experimental results.


That makes you stand out

  • You are currently pursuing a degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, robotics, electrical engineering, data science, or a related field.
  • You have excellent programming skills in Python as well as hands-on experience with PyTorch.
  • You have a good understanding of computer vision, deep learning, 3D geometry, or multi-view vision.
  • Experience with depth estimation, optical flow, point clouds, camera pose estimation, NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting, or 3D reconstruction is highly beneficial.
  • Your language skills enable you to perform your role in English (at least C1 level). Knowledge of German is desirable but not required.


Salary information

Within our standardized and transparent salary framework, the pay for this position ranges from €15.50 to €19.50 per hour and is based on various factors, such as qualifications and experience.

title: Software Engineer - Data (All Genders)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at PREMATCH Sports GmbH
description_html:
Hey!

Imagine amateur football finally had the platform it deserves.
Every weekend, millions of people write their own personal football stories – on pitches, in clubs and on the sidelines. We believe this passion deserves a digital home too.
That's exactly what we're building every single day.


tl;dr

We’re looking for someone to help make our Teamwear business scalable beyond its current scope - building the data infrastructure, pipelines and tools that power the next stage of Teamwear.


Main information

  • Start: Immediately
  • Location: Cologne, Berlin London or Remote
  • Workload: Full-time
  • Team: Teamwear/Tech


Is this a match?

The most important basics – so we both know if it could work.

  • 100% remote: This role is generally available 100% remote within the EU or UK. If you'd still love to work from one of our offices in Cologne, Berlin or London - you're more than welcome.
  • Experience: You bring 6-8 years of experience in software engineering and data engineering.
  • Languages: You speak English fluently - German is a big plus.
  • Startup spirit: You'd rather shape things than just tick boxes - even when that means figuring stuff out without a finished roadmap.


What you'll do - your playing field

This is how you move our mission forward every day.

  • Data Pipelines: You build and maintain data pipelines for automated data collection, structured so that new sources and markets can be added quickly.
  • Algorithms: You develop algorithms to extract relevant information from websites and images.
  • Data Quality: You ensure data quality through validation, confidence levels, monitoring, and clean handovers internally and to partners.
  • Data Infrastructure: You manage and further develop the data infrastructure of the Teamwear area.
  • Technical Point of Contact: You act as the second technical point of contact for the Teamwear area.
In addition to your core responsibilities, you will also:
  • Internal Tools: You develop internal tools that enable the team to collect and correct data themselves.
  • Analytics & Reports: You create analytics and reports for internal stakeholders and external partners.


What you bring to the team

We're not looking for a perfect CV. But you should recognise yourself in these points.

  • Broad Technical Skillset: You move between data pipelines, backend and some frontend, and are not afraid of AI or image analysis.
  • Data Automation: You have experience with automated data pipelines, web scraping and image processing.
  • Databases & Data Modelling: You have expertise in databases and data modelling.
  • Independent Working: You work independently, even when there is no second engineer in the room and the context comes from business teams.
  • Fast Learner: You quickly get familiar with unfamiliar domains and ask the right questions along the way.
  • 80/20 Mindset: You know when fast and good enough is the right approach and when the data needs to be 100% accurate because a decision is based on it.
  • Data Quality: You care about details when it comes to data quality and make uncertainties explicit.
  • Data-Driven Thinking: You don't stop at analysing the data. You identify what is in the data, what it means and what we should look at next - even if nobody asked.
  • Engineering Practice: You write clean, maintainable code and follow good engineering practices such as testing and code reviews.
  • Tools: Python, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Grafana, Metabase, Pulumi, Kubernetes, AWS, LLM APIs
Good to know
We want you to know what this role really looks like from day one.
  • If you are looking for clearly defined tickets, a large engineering team and a finished tech stack, this role is probably not for you.
    • You will work largely as a team of two within Engineering. Most of your day-to-day work will be with business people, not engineers.
    • You have two connections: technically to Engineering and on the content side to the Teamwear team. This gives you a lot of freedom and means you need to set your own priorities.
    • A large part of the role is data collection and data quality, rather than greenfield ML. The exciting part is turning messy, real-world sources into reliable data.
    • The area is new. There is no finished setup for you to work with - you will help build it.
    • AI-first: We work AI-first, and AI tools are an active part of our workflow.


Bonus

Not a must - but this'll definitely earn you extra points.

  • Experience with AWS, Kubernetes or IaC (Pulumi/Terraform). You can also learn this with us.
  • Experience presenting and preparing data for non-technical audiences.
  • A personal connection to amateur football.

description_html:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

As the Team Lead for the backend, frontend, mobile and fullstack software engineers, you will own and shape the architecture of the underlying services as well as their technical roadmap for the services that together create Treeline, our application that helps predict and prevent wildfires, storm events and generally power and train outages due to vegetation, weather and climate.

Technically, that means rendering and querying large volumes of geospatial data efficiently in both browser, mobile and backend, handling complex and custom business logic, writing the services that make that fast, and building integrations for the growing number of third-party consumers of our services.

We are a team of five engineers today, actively growing, embedded in a cross-functional group of product managers, UX/UI designers, data, DevOps, ML, and geospatial engineering experts. You will not be the only person responsible for any system you touch and we’re a friendly bunch.


Your challenge

  • Lead, support and coordinate the team that builds Treeline while still being around 60% hands-on
  • Architect, build and extend features end-to-end that handle large volumes of geospatial data, with attention to UX and design
  • Design and build well-designed, performant API endpoints and backend services used by partners and customers
  • Coordinate tightly with other functions in cross-functional temporary squads
  • Shape and influence how your team works and how we work together in a greater context

Stack:
  • Frontend: React, TypeScript
  • Backend: NestJS, TypeORM
  • Mobile: React Native
  • Database: PostgreSQL (including geospatial workloads, PostGIS and OGC)
  • Infrastructure & CI/CD: AWS, GitLab


Your profile

Must have

  • First experience as a team lead, knowing that the team and product takes priority over your own hands-on work, always
  • Strong Backend experience with NestJS, Express, or Node.js
  • High level of TypeScript, React in production (Vue or Preact also fine — we care that you know a component model well, not which one)
  • You've worked in a codebase with CI/CD and code review, and can find your way around a system you didn't build
  • You've used AI-assisted coding in your actual day-to-day, not just tried it once
Nice to have
  • Spec-driven or test-driven development, agentic or otherwise
  • Web-based geospatial / GIS work
  • Familiarity with mobile development, especially React Native
  • An eye for design and UX — enough to make small design calls without needing a mockup for everything


Your Benefits

  • The opportunity to create a product that can improve business processes and lives across the globe.
  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work model - we trust our employees to get their work done while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.
  • We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold.
  • Not an overtime culture - we take care that overtime is done only as a necessity and always offset with time off and rest.
  • A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons.
  • Office located in the centre of Berlin Kreuzberg with free fruit, nuts and drinks.
  • Potential to participate in the employee stock option program.
  • Urban Sports membership and BVG subsidy, corporate pension program.
  • A diverse and vibrant international environment of 30+ different nationalities.

description_html:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager (ISR) (f/m/x) to own the product and delivery side of LiveEO's defence and intelligence business. Sektion 4 builds AI-based ISR capabilities for German and allied defence and intelligence customers: object and change detection in very high resolution satellite imagery, 3D terrain products derived from stereo imagery, and the analytics that turn imagery into decisions. You will run our customer-facing defence products end to end from a product management perspective including analytical products as well as end user applications. You will also build the roadmap that connects different customer timelines, our concept of operations and the actual maturity of our technical components into one plan that engineering and sales both work from. This role exists because our LiveEO engineers build world class AI models and your work will help to bring them into operations and roll them out to many more end users. We need someone who can say how an analyst does the job, write requirements a military user would recognise, and hold the line on what we ship.

LiveEO is a dynamic team that thrives on big challenges and fast learning cycles. We move quickly, stay curious, and genuinely enjoy building together. We are on a mission to break the "curse of Earth Observation": turning incredible satellite data into reliable, actionable decisions that people can trust and use in real operations on scale. 

You will be part of Sektion 4, LiveEO's government-solutions product team. Sektion 4 owns its roadmap and delivers funded R&D projects and defence engagements end-to-end, from research through to production, and sets its own technical direction. You will work day to day with the team's ML engineergs, full-stack engineers and geospatial data egineers, and across LiveEO with sales, pre-sales and the teams building the Twinspector satellite programme. Externally you are in front of military and agency users, partners and integrators, in workshops, requirement sessions and user tests.

  • Linear (backlog, sprints)
  • Confluence
  • Google Workspace 
  • LiveEO's own ISR and analytics applications
  • Figma 
  • QGIS and comparable viewers
  • STAC-based imagery catalogs Data:
  • very high resolution optical imagery
  • synthetic aperture radar
  • 3D surface models 
  • cloud and secure on-premise / air-gapped deployments
  • agentic tools for a variety of work.


Your challenge

  • Own the ISR product: take our imagery intelligence application from working demonstrator to deployable product. Define the release scope, the deployment and support model for secure on-premise environments, and drive the first installation at a real user.

  • Be the ISR authority in the team: bring operational depth on the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and imagery exploitation. Be the person engineering asks how an analyst would really use this, and the person sales asks what we can credibly claim.

  • Work with users and customers: run workshops and user sessions, gather and structure feedback, demonstrate the product, and support bids and proposals with operational substance.


Your profile

  • Professional ISR, GEOINT or IMINT background: Bundeswehr, the intelligence community, defence procurement, or an ISR role in industry.

  • Real operational fluency in the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and how imagery products are produced and consumed at a staff.

  • Proven ability to translate operational needs into written requirements that engineers can build from. Track record of driving work to a deadline across dependencies you did not control.

  • German or European citizenship and eligibility to obtain a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung).

  • Pragmatic mindset: you balance operational ambition with what can actually be shipped.

  • You enjoy working with complexity and turning ambiguity into structure.
